0.en: Principle of a Philosophy in the Form of an Absolute Fundamental Proposition
0.zh: 以绝对根本命题的形式出现的哲学原理

en: Philosophy, as a totality of knowing produced through reflection, becomes a system, an organic whole of concepts, whose highest law is not the understanding but reason; the former has correctly to point out the opposed of what it posits, its limit, ground and condition, but reason unites these contradictory ones, posits both at the same time and sublates both.

To the system, as an organization of propositions, the demand can be made that the absolute, which lies at the ground of reflection, be present in it also in the manner of reflection as the supreme absolute fundamental proposition.

But such a demand already carries its nullity within itself; for something posited through reflection, a proposition, is for itself something limited and conditioned and needs another for its grounding, and so on into the infinite.

If the absolute is expressed in a fundamental proposition valid through and for thinking, whose form and matter are supposed to be the same, then either mere sameness is posited and the unsameness of form and matter is excluded, and the fundamental proposition is conditioned by this unsameness; in this case the fundamental proposition is not absolute but defective, it expresses only a concept of the understanding, an abstraction; - or form and matter, as unsameness, is at the same time contained in it, the proposition is analytic and synthetic at once: then the fundamental proposition is an antinomy and thereby not a proposition, as a proposition it stands under the law of the understanding that it not contradict itself, not sublate itself, but be something posited; as antinomy, however, it sublates itself.
zh: 哲学作为通过反思生产出来的知识的总体性，会成为一个体系，一个概念的有机器官整体，它的最高法律不是知性，而是理性；知性要正确地指出它所设定的东西的对立面，指出它的界限、根据和条件，而理性则把这些互相矛盾的东西联合起来，同时设定两者并扬弃两者。
对于体系，作为命题的一种组织，可以提出这样的要求：那个为反思奠定根据的绝对者，也要按照反思的方式，作为最高的绝对根本命题而存在于体系之中。
但这样一种要求本身就带有自己的虚无性；因为一个通过反思而被设定的东西，一个命题，自在地就是一个受限的、有条件的东西，需要另一个东西来为它提供根据，如此一直下去，以至无限。

如果绝对者被表达在一个对思维有效、也为思维有效的根本命题里，而这个命题的形式和质料应当是同样的，那么，要么设定了单纯的等同，而把形式和质料的不等同排除掉了，于是这个根本命题就被这种不等同所制约；在这种情况下，根本命题不是绝对的，而是有缺陷的，它表达出来的只是一个知性概念，一种抽象；——要么形式和质料作为不等同也同时包含在它里面，于是这个命题既是分析的又是综合的：这时根本命题就是一个二律背反，因此就不是一个命题，它作为命题处在知性的法律之下，即它不在自身中自相矛盾，不扬弃自己，而是一个被设定的东西；但作为二律背反，它却扬弃自己。

en: This delusion, that something posited only for reflection must necessarily stand at the head of a system as the supreme absolute fundamental proposition, or that the essence of every system can be expressed in a proposition that is absolute for thinking, makes easy work of a system to which it applies its judgement; for of a thought that the proposition expresses it can very easily be proved that it is conditioned by an opposite, hence not absolute; and of this opposite to the proposition it is proved that it must be posited, that therefore that thought which the proposition expresses is null.

The delusion considers itself all the more justified when the system itself expresses the absolute, which is its principle, in the form of a proposition or a definition, which however is at bottom an antinomy and therefore sublates itself as something posited for mere reflection; thus, for example, Spinoza's concept of substance, which is explained as cause and effect, as concept and being at the same time, ceases to be a concept, because the opposed are united into a contradiction. - No beginning of a philosophy can have a worse look than the beginning with a definition as in Spinoza - a beginning that makes the strangest contrast with the grounding, fathoming, deducing of the principles of knowing, with the laborious tracing back of all philosophy to the highest facts of consciousness, etc.

But when reason has purified itself of the subjectivity of reflecting, then that simplicity of Spinoza, which begins philosophy with philosophy itself and lets reason appear immediately with an antinomy, can also be properly appreciated.
zh: 这种妄想——即一个仅仅为反思而设定的东西必然要作为最高的绝对根本命题站在一个体系的顶端，或者每个体系的本质都可以用一个对思维来说绝对的命题表达出来——在它把自己的评判应用于一个体系时，做起来是很轻松的；因为对于一个由命题表达出来的被思维的东西，很容易证明它是由一个对立面制约的，因而并不是绝对的；而对这个与命题相对立的东西则要证明它必须被设定，因而那个由命题表达出来的被思维的东西是虚无的。

当体系自己把绝对者、即它的原则，用命题或定义的形式表达出来，而这个命题或定义在根本上是一个二律背反，因而对于单纯反思来说作为一种被设定的东西自己扬弃自己时，这种妄想就更加觉得自己有道理了；例如斯宾诺莎的实体概念——实体同时被解释为原因和被造成的东西，被解释为概念和存在——就不再是一个概念，因为那些对立面被联合进了一个矛盾。 ——没有一种哲学的开端会比像斯宾诺莎那样以一个定义作开端更难看的了——这样一个开端，与对知识的诸原则的论证、探究根据、演绎，与费力地把全部哲学回溯到意识的最高事实等等，形成了最奇特的对照。
但当理性清除了反思活动的主观性之后，斯宾诺莎那种素朴也可以得到应有的评价：那种素朴让哲学以哲学本身为开端，并且让理性直接就以一个二律背反出场。

en: If the principle of philosophy is to be pronounced in formal propositions for reflection, then at first nothing is present as the object of this task but knowing, in general the synthesis of the subjective and the objective, or absolute thinking.

But reflection is unable to express the absolute synthesis in one proposition, namely if this proposition is to count as a proper proposition for the understanding; it must separate what is one in the absolute identity and express synthesis and antithesis separately, in two propositions, in the one identity, in the other diremption.
zh: 如果哲学的原则要为反思而用形式的命题说出来，那么作为这项任务的对象，最初现成存在的除了知识别无他物，即一般说来主观的东西和客观的东西的综合，或者说绝对的思维。
但反思没有能力在一个命题里表达绝对的综合，如果这个命题要作为知性的真正命题而有效的话；反思必须把在绝对同一性中是一的东西分开，把综合和反题分开来表达，用两个命题，在一个里表达同一性，在另一个里表达分裂。

en: In A = A, as the proposition of identity, what is reflected upon is being-related, and this relating, this being one, this equality, is contained in this pure identity; abstraction is made from all inequality.

A = A, the expression of absolute thinking or of reason, has for the formal reflection that speaks in propositions of the understanding only the meaning of the identity of the understanding, of pure unity, i.e. of a unity in which abstraction is made from opposition.
zh: 在 A = A 中，作为同一性命题，所反思的是那种被关联状态，而这种关联、这种一体、这种相等，都包含在这个纯粹同一性里；一切不相等都被抽掉。
A = A 是绝对思维或理性的表达，但对于那种形式的、在知性命题里说话的反思来说，它只有知性同一性的意义，只有纯粹统一的意义，也就是只有一种抽掉了对立的统一的意义。

en: But reason does not find itself expressed in this one-sidedness of abstract unity; it also postulates the positing of that from which abstraction was made in pure equality, the positing of the opposed, of inequality; the one A is subject, the other object, and the expression for their difference is A is not = A, or A = B. This proposition contradicts the previous one outright; in it abstraction is made from pure identity, and non-identity, the pure form of non-thinking8), is posited, just as the first posits the form of pure thinking [setzt], which is something other than absolute thinking, reason.

Only because non-thinking too is thought, because A is not = A is posited through thinking, can it be posited at all; in A is not = A or A = B the identity, the relating, the = of the first proposition, is likewise present, but only subjectively, i.e. only insofar as non-thinking is posited through thinking.

But this being-posited of non-thinking for thinking is thoroughly accidental for non-thinking, a mere thing for the second proposition, from which abstraction must be made if its matter is to be had pure.
zh: 但理性发觉自己在这种抽象统一的片面性里并没有得到表达；它还要求设定那种在纯粹相等中被抽掉的东西，设定对立面，即不相等；这一个 A 是主体，另一个 A 是客体，而它们差别的表达就是 A 不等于 A，或者 A = B。这个命题与前面那个命题正好相反；在它里面，从纯粹同一性抽掉了，而非同一性，即非思维的纯粹形式8)，则被设定了，正如第一个命题设定的是纯粹思维的形式[setzt]，而这形式是不同于绝对思维、即理性的另一种东西。
只因为非思维也被思维，A 不等于 A 也是通过思维被设定的，它才能被设定；在 A 不等于 A 或者 A = B 里，同一性、关联、第一个命题的那个 =，同样也在，但只是主观地，也就是说，只就非思维是通过思维被设定的而言。
但对非思维来说，这种为思维而被设定的非思维之被设定状态完全是偶然的，是一种单单为第二个命题才有的东西，要纯粹地得到它的质料，就必须从这种东西里抽掉。

en: This second proposition is as unconditioned as the first and to that extent the condition of the first, just as the first is the condition of the second proposition.

The first is conditioned by the second insofar as it subsists through the abstraction from the unsameness that the second proposition contains; the second, insofar as it needs a relation in order to be a proposition.
zh: 这第二个命题与第一个命题一样是无条件的，就此而言它是第一个命题的条件，正如第一个命题是第二个命题的条件一样。
第一个命题受第二个命题制约，就它靠从第二个命题所包含的不等同中抽象掉才得以持存而言；第二个命题则受第一个命题制约，就它要成为一个命题就需要一种关系而言。

en: The second proposition has otherwise been expressed under the subordinate form of the proposition of ground; or rather, it has first been dragged down into this most subordinate meaning by the fact that it has been made the proposition of causality.

A has a ground, means: there belongs to A a being that is not a being of A, A is a being-posited that is not the being-posited of A; thus A is not = A, A = B. If abstraction is made from the fact that A is something posited, as abstraction must be made in order to have the second proposition pure, then it expresses a not-being-posited of A altogether.
To posit A as posited and as not-posited at the same time is already the synthesis of the first and second propositions.
zh: 第二个命题平时是以根据命题的那种次级形式说出来的；或者不如说，它是由于人们把它变成了因果性命题，才被拉低到这种极其次级的含义上的。
A 有一个根据，意思是：A 具有一种存在，而这种存在并不是 A 的存在，A 是一种被设定状态，而这种被设定状态并不是 A 的被设定状态；所以 A 不等于 A，A = B。如果从 A 是被设定者这一点抽掉，正如为了纯粹地得到第二个命题而必须抽掉的那样，那么它表达的恰恰是 A 的非被设定状态。
把 A 同时设定为被设定者和非被设定者，这已经是第一个命题和第二个命题的综合了。

en: Both propositions are propositions of contradiction, only in the inverted sense.
The first, the proposition of identity, states that contradiction = 0; the second, insofar as it is related to the first, states that contradiction is just as necessary as non-contradiction.
Both are, as propositions, posited things of equal potency, each for itself.

Insofar as the second is expressed in such a way that the first is at the same time related to it, it is the highest possible expression of reason through the understanding; this relation of the two is the expression of the antinomy, and as antinomy, as expression of absolute identity, it is a matter of indifference whether A = B or A = A is posited, namely when A = B and A = A are taken as the relation of both propositions.
A = A contains the difference of A as subject and A as object together with the identity, just as A = B contains the identity of A and B together with the difference of the two.
zh: 这两个命题都是矛盾命题，只不过是在颠倒的意义上。
第一个命题，即同一性命题，说的是矛盾 = 0；第二个命题，只要它被联系到第一个命题上，说的就是矛盾与不矛盾同样必然。
两者作为命题，各自都是级次相同的被设定者。
只要第二个命题是这样说出来的，即第一个命题同时也被联系到它上面，那么它就是理性通过知性所能达到的最高表达；两者的这种关系就是二律背反的表达，而作为二律背反，作为绝对同一性的表达，设定 A = B 还是设定 A = A 都无所谓，只要 A = B 和 A = A 是被当作两个命题的关系来取的。
A = A 把 A 作为主体和 A 作为客体的差别与同一性一起包含在内，正如 A = B 把 A 和 B 的同一性与两者的差别一起包含在内。

en: If the understanding does not recognize the antinomy in the proposition of ground, as a relation of both, then it has not attained to reason, and formaliter the second proposition is not a new one for it.

For the mere understanding A = B states no more than the first proposition; the understanding then comprehends the being-posited of A as B only as a repetition of A, i.e. it holds fast only the identity and abstracts from the fact that, in that A is repeated as posited as B or in B, an other, a non-A, is posited, and indeed as A, hence A as non-A. - If one reflects merely on what is formal in speculation and holds fast the synthesis of knowing in analytic form, then the antinomy, the self-sublating contradiction, is the highest formal expression of knowing and of truth.
zh: 如果知性在根据命题中，即作为两者的关系，认不出二律背反，那么它就没有达到理性，而从形式上说（formaliter），第二个命题对它来说也不是新的。

对于单纯的知性来说，A = B 并不比第一个命题说出更多的东西；这时知性把 A 作为 B 的被设定状态只理解为 A 的一种重复，也就是说，它只抓住同一性，而从这一点中抽象掉：当 A 作为 B 或在 B 中被设定而重复时，被设定的是一个别的东西，一个非 A，而且是被设定为 A，所以是 A 作为非 A。 ——如果人只反思思辨的形式方面，并把知识的综合固定在分析的形式里，那么二律背反、即自己扬弃自己的矛盾，就是知识和真理的最高的形式表达。

en: In the antinomy, when it is recognized as the formal expression of truth, reason has brought the formal essence of reflection under itself.

But the formal essence has the upper hand when thinking is to be posited, in the single form of the first proposition, which is opposed to the second, with the character of an abstract unity, as the first true of philosophy, and a system of the reality of cognition is to be erected out of the analysis of the application of thinking.
Then the whole course of this purely analytic business turns out in the following way.
zh: 在二律背反中，当它被承认为真理的形式表达时，理性就把反思的形式本质置于自己之下。
但形式本质占上风，是当思维要以第一个命题、即与第二个命题相对立的那个命题的唯一形式，带着抽象统一的性格，被设定为哲学最初的真，并且要从对思维应用的分析中建立起一个认识的实在性的体系的时候。
于是，这项纯然分析的工作的整个进程就如下所示。

en: Thinking, as the infinite repeatability of A as A, is an abstraction, the first proposition expressed as activity.
But now the second proposition, non-thinking, is missing; one must necessarily pass over to it as the condition of the first, and this too, the matter, must be posited.
With this the opposed are complete, and the transition is a certain kind of relation of the two to each other, which is called an application of thinking and is a most incomplete synthesis.

But even this weak synthesis itself goes on into the infinite against the presupposition of thinking as the positing of A as A; for in the application A is at the same time posited as non-A, and thinking in its absolute subsistence is sublated as an infinite repetition of A as A. - The opposed of thinking is determined, through its relation to thinking, as a thought = A. But because such a thinking, positing = A, is conditioned by an abstraction and is therefore an opposed, the thought too, besides being thought = A, has yet other determinations = B, which are quite independent of the mere being-determined through pure thinking, and these are merely given to thinking.
Thus for thinking, as the principle of analytical philosophizing, there must be an absolute stuff, of which more will be said further below.

The ground of this absolute opposition leaves to the formal business in which the famous invention of reducing philosophy to logic9) consists no other immanent synthesis than that of the identity of the understanding, to repeat A into the infinite.

But even for repetition it needs a B, C, etc., in which the repeated A can be posited; these B, C, D, etc., are, for the sake of the repeatability of A, a manifold, something opposed to itself - each has particular determinations not posited through A -, i.e. an absolutely manifold stuff, whose B, C, D, etc., must fit together with A as best it can; such an absurdity of fitting takes the place of an original identity.
The fundamental error can be presented thus, that in formal respect no reflection is made on the antinomy of A = A and of A = B.

Such an analytical being does not have at its ground the consciousness that the purely formal appearance of the absolute is contradiction, - a consciousness that can only arise if speculation starts from reason and from A = A as the absolute identity of subject and object.
zh: 思维，作为 A 作为 A 的无限可重复性，是一种抽象，是作为活动表达出来的第一个命题。
但现在缺的是第二个命题，即非思维；必然要过渡到它那里，把它当作第一个命题的条件，并且也要把这种东西，即质料，设定起来。
这样一来，对立面就完整了，而这种过渡是两个对立面相互之间的一种关系，这种关系叫做思维的应用，是一种极不完全的综合。

但就连这种微弱的综合，本身也与思维作为 A 作为 A 的设定这一前提相反而无限地继续下去；因为在应用里，A 同时被设定为非 A，而思维在它绝对的持存中则作为 A 作为 A 的无限重复而被扬弃了。——思维的对立面通过它与思维的关系，被规定为被思维者 = A。但由于这样一种思维，即设定 = A，是以一种抽象为条件的，因而是一个对立面，所以被思维者除了是被思维者 = A 之外，还有另一些规定 = B，这些规定与纯粹思维对它的单纯规定完全无关，而它们对思维来说只是被给予的。
所以，对思维来说，作为分析式哲学的原则，必然有一种绝对的材料，后面还会谈到它。
这种绝对对立的基础，对于那种形式的事务——把哲学归结为逻辑9)这个著名发明就立足于这种事务——，除了知性同一性之外，不给它留下任何内在的综合，即无限地重复 A。
但它就连重复也需要 B、C 等等，好让被重复的 A 能在其中被设定；这些 B、C、D 等等，为了 A 的可重复性的缘故，是一种杂多，是一种相互对立的东西——每一个都有并非由 A 设定的特殊规定——，也就是说，是一种绝对杂多的材料，它的 B、C、D 等等只能尽其所能地与 A 凑合在一起；这样一种凑合上的荒谬，就代替了原始同一性。
这个根本错误可以这样设想：在形式方面，并没有反思到 A = A 与 A = B 的二律背反。
这样一种分析式的本质，其根据里并没有这个意识：绝对者的纯粹形式的现象就是矛盾——这种意识只有在思辨从理性、从作为主体与客体绝对同一性的 A = A 出发时才能产生。

en: Insofar as speculation is regarded from the side of mere reflection, the absolute identity appears in syntheses of the opposed, hence in antinomies.

The relative identities into which the absolute differentiates itself are indeed limited and to that extent for the understanding and not antinomic; at the same time, however, because they are identities, they are not pure concepts of the understanding; and they must be identities, because in a philosophy nothing posited can stand without relation to the absolute.

But from the side of this relation, even every limited thing is a (relative) identity and to that extent something antinomic for reflection, - and this is the negative side of knowing, the formal, which, governed by reason, destroys itself.
Besides this negative side, knowing has a positive side, namely intuition.
Pure knowing (that would mean knowing without intuition) is the annihilation of the opposed in contradiction; intuition without this synthesis of the opposed is empirical, given, unconscious.
Transcendental knowing unites both, reflection and intuition; it is concept and being at the same time.

Through intuition becoming transcendental, the identity of the subjective and the objective, which are separated in empirical intuition, enters consciousness; knowing, insofar as it becomes transcendental, posits not merely the concept and its condition or the antinomy of both, the subjective, - but at the same time the objective, being.
In philosophical knowing the intuited is an activity of intelligence and of nature, of the conscious and the unconscious at the same time.

It belongs to both worlds at once, the ideal and the real, - to the ideal, in that it is posited in intelligence and thereby in freedom, - to the real, in that it has its place in the objective totality, is deduced as a ring in the chain of necessity.

If one places oneself on the standpoint of reflection or of freedom, then the ideal is the first, and essence and being only schematized intelligence; if one places oneself on the standpoint of necessity or of being, then thinking is only a schema of absolute being.

In transcendental knowing both are united, being and intelligence; likewise transcendental knowing and transcendental intuiting are one and the same: the different expression indicates only the predominance of the ideal or the real factor.
zh: 就思辨从单纯反思的方面被看待而言，绝对同一性显现在对立面的种种综合中，因而显现在二律背反中。
绝对者把自己区分成的那些相对的同一性，虽然是受限的，就此而言是为知性的，并且不是二律背反的；但同时，因为它们毕竟是同一性，所以它们并不是纯粹的知性概念；而它们必须是同一性，因为在一种哲学里，没有任何被设定的东西能够不带对绝对者的关系而站立。
但从这种关系的方面看，就连每一个受限的东西也是一种（相对的）同一性，就此而言对反思来说是一个二律背反式的东西，——而这就是知识的否定方面，即形式的东西，它在理性的统治下自己毁灭自己。
除了这个否定的方面，知识还有一个肯定的方面，即直观。
纯粹的知识（那意味着没有直观的知识）是对立面在矛盾中的消灭；没有这种对立面的综合的直观则是经验的、被给予的、无意识的。
先验的知识把两者、即反思和直观联合起来；它同时是概念和存在。
由于直观成为先验的，主观的东西和客观的东西的同一性就进入意识，而这两者在经验的直观中是分开的；知识就它成为先验的而言，不仅设定概念及其条件，或两者的二律背反，即主观的东西，——而且同时设定客观的东西，即存在。
在哲学知识中，被直观到的东西同时是智性和自然的活动，是意识和无意识的东西的活动。
它同时属于两个世界，观念的世界和实在的世界，——属于观念的世界，因为它在智性中、并由此在自由中被设定，——属于实在的世界，因为它在客观的总体性中[有]自己的位置，被演绎为必然性链条上的一个环。
如果人站到反思或自由的立足点上，那么观念物就是第一位的，而本质和存在只是被图式化的智性；如果人站到必然性或存在的立足点上，那么思维只是绝对存在的一个图式。
在先验的知识中，两者、即存在和智性被联合起来；同样，先验的知识和先验的直观是同一个东西：不同的表达只是指向观念的或实在的因素占优势。

en: It is of the deepest significance that it has been asserted with so much seriousness that one cannot philosophize without transcendental intuition.
What, then, would it mean to philosophize without intuition?

To scatter oneself endlessly in absolute finitudes; whether these finitudes be subjective or objective, concepts or things, or whether a transition is also made from the one kind to the other, philosophizing without intuition goes on along an endless series of finitudes, and the transition from being to the concept or from the concept to being is an unjustified leap.

Such a philosophizing is called a formal one, for thing as well as concept is, each for itself, only a form of the absolute; it presupposes the destruction of transcendental intuition, an absolute opposition of being and concept, and when it speaks of the unconditioned, it again turns even this into something formal, for instance in the form of an idea that is supposed to be opposed to being.
The better the method is, the more glaring the results become.
For speculation the finitudes are radii of the infinite focus, which radiates them out and is at the same time formed by them; in them the focus is posited and in the focus they are posited.

In transcendental intuition all opposition is sublated, all difference between the construction of the universe through and for intelligence and its organization, intuited as something objective and appearing independent, is annihilated.
The producing of the consciousness of this identity is speculation, and because ideality and reality are one in it, it is intuition.
zh: 这件事具有最深刻的意义：人们曾如此严肃地断言，没有先验直观就不能作哲学思考。
那么，没有直观而作哲学思考，究竟意味着什么呢？
那就是在绝对的有限性中无尽地散开；这些有限性无论是主观的还是客观的，是概念还是物，也不管人们是否从一种过渡到另一种，没有直观的哲学思考都沿着一条无尽的有限性序列继续下去，而从存在到概念的过渡或从概念到存在的过渡，则是一种没有正当理由的跳跃。
这样一种哲学思考叫作形式的，因为物和概念各自单独来看都只是绝对者的形式；它预设了先验直观的毁灭，预设了存在与概念的绝对对立，而当它谈到无条件者时，它又把连这个也重新变成形式的东西，比如变成一种据说是与存在相对立的观念的形式。
方法越好，得出的结果就越刺眼。
对思辨来说，有限性是无限焦点的半径，这个焦点放射出它们，同时又由它们构成；焦点被设定在它们之中，它们也被设定在焦点之中。
在先验直观中，一切对立都被扬弃了，宇宙通过智性并为智性而作的建构，与它那种被直观为客观的东西、显得独立的组织之间，一切差别都被消灭了。
生产这种同一性的意识，就是思辨；而由于观念性和实在性在思辨中是一，思辨就是直观。

en: The synthesis of the two opposites posited by reflection demanded, as a work of reflection, its completion - as an antinomy that sublates itself, its subsistence in intuition.

Because speculative knowledge must be conceived as the identity of reflection and intuition, one can, insofar as the share of reflection (which, as rational, is antinomical) is posited alone, yet stands in a necessary relation to intuition, say of intuition in this case that it is postulated by reflection.
There can be no question of postulating ideas; for these are products of reason, or rather the rational posited as a product by the understanding.

The rational must, according to its determinate content, namely out of the contradiction of determinate opposites whose synthesis the rational is, be deduced; only the intuition that fills out and holds fast this antinomical element is what can be postulated.

One such idea, otherwise postulated, is the infinite progress, a mixture of the empirical and the rational; the former is the intuition of time, the latter the sublation of all time, its infinitization; in the empirical progress, however, time is not purely infinitized, for it is to subsist in that progress as something finite, as limited moments - the progress is an empirical infinity.

The true antinomy, which posits both the limited and the unlimited not side by side but at the same time as identical, must thereby at the same time sublate the opposition; in that the antinomy postulates the determinate intuition of time, this intuition - limited moment of the present and unlimitedness of its being-posited-outside-itself - must be both at once, thus eternity.
zh: 由反思所设定的两个对立面的综合，作为反思的作品，要求自己得到补全——而作为自行扬弃的二律背反，它要求自己在直观中持存。
因为思辨知识必须被理解为反思与直观的同一性，所以，只要单独设定反思的那一份（这一份作为理性的东西是二律背反式的），而它又必然与直观相关，那么在这种情形下就可以说，直观是由反思公设出来的。
根本谈不上把观念公设出来；因为观念是理性的产物，或者更确切地说，是理性的东西通过知性而被设定为产物。
理性的东西必须按其确定的内容、也就是从确定的诸对立面的矛盾中——理性的东西就是这些对立面的综合——被演绎出来；只有把这种二律背反的东西充实起来并持守住的那种直观，才是可公设的东西。
一种这样通常被公设的观念就是无限进展，是经验的东西与理性的东西的混合；前者是时间的直观，后者是对一切时间的扬弃，是时间的无限化；但在经验性的进展中，时间并没有被纯粹地无限化，因为时间在进展中应当作为有限的东西、作为受限制的环节而持存——这种进展是一种经验性的无限性。
真正的二律背反把受限制者和不受限制者不是并置起来，而是同时设定为同一的，因此它必然同时扬弃对立；二律背反既然公设了时间的确定直观，这直观——当下的受限制环节与它被设定在自身之外的那种不受限制性——就必须同时是两者，也就是永恒。

en: Just as little can intuition be demanded as something opposed to the idea, or better, to the necessary antinomy.
The intuition that is opposed to the idea is limited determinate being, precisely because it excludes the idea.

Intuition is indeed what reason postulates, but not as something limited, rather for the completion of the one-sidedness of the work of reflection, not so that they remain opposed to each other, but so that they be one.

One sees in general that this whole manner of postulating has its ground solely in the fact that one starts from the one-sidedness of reflection; this one-sidedness needs, for the supplementing of its defectiveness, to postulate the opposed that is excluded from it.
But in this view the essence of reason gets a skewed position, for reason here appears as something not sufficient to itself, but as something needy.
But if reason knows itself as absolute, then philosophy begins with that with which that manner which starts from reflection ceases: with the identity of the idea and being.
It does not postulate the one, for with absoluteness it immediately posits both, and the absoluteness of reason is nothing other than the identity of the two.
zh: 同样不能要求直观作为与观念、或者更确切地说与必然的二律背反相对立的东西。
与观念相对立的直观是受限制的定在，正因为它把观念排除在外。
直观确实是理性所公设的东西，但不是作为受限制的东西，而是为了补全反思作品的那种片面性，不是为了它们彼此保持对立，而是为了它们成为一。
总的来说可以看出，这种公设方式之所以有它的根据，仅仅在于出发点是反思的片面性；这种片面性为了补足自己的欠缺，就需要把被它排除在外的对立面公设出来。
但在这种看法里，理性的本质得到了一个歪斜的位置，因为理性在这里显得不是自足的东西，而是有需要的东西。
但如果理性认识到自己是绝对的，那么哲学就从那种从反思出发的做法所终止的地方开始：从观念与存在的同一性开始。
理性并不公设其中一方，因为它随绝对性直接设定双方，而理性的绝对性不外是双方的同一性。

18.en: The Relation of Philosophizing to a Philosophical System
18.zh: 哲学思考与一个哲学体系的关系

en: The need of philosophy can be satisfied in this, that it has penetrated to the principle of the annihilation of all fixed opposition and to the relation of the limited to the absolute.
This satisfaction in the principle of absolute identity is found in philosophizing in general.

What is known would, according to its content, be something contingent; the diremptions at whose annihilation it aimed would be given and vanished and not themselves again constructed syntheses; the content of such a philosophizing would have no coherence at all among itself and would not make up an objective totality of knowledge.
Because of the incoherence of its content alone, this philosophizing is precisely not necessarily a reasoning.

The latter disperses the posited only into a greater manifoldness, and if, plunged into this stream, it swims without hold, then the whole, itself holdless, expanse of the manifold of the understanding is to persist; for true, though incoherent, philosophizing, by contrast, the posited and its opposites vanish, in that it brings the same not merely into connection with other limited things, but into relation to the absolute, and thereby sublates it.
zh: 哲学的需要可以在这一点上得到满足：它已经深入到消灭一切被固定下来的对立的原则，深入到受限制者与绝对者的关系。
这种在绝对同一性的原则中得到的满足，在一般的哲学思考中就能找到。
被知道的东西按其内容就会是偶然的东西；那些它要消灭的分裂就是被给予的、已经消逝的，而不是自身重新建构起来的综合；这样一种哲学思考的内容在自身之内根本没有什么联系，也构不成知识的一种客观总体性。
仅凭它内容上的无联系，这种哲学思考恰恰不必是一种推理。
后者只是把被设定的东西分散到更大的杂多中去，而如果它被抛进这股水流、无持守地漂着，那么知性杂多的整个同样无持守的伸展就应当留存下来；相反，对于真实的、尽管无联系的哲学思考来说，被设定的东西及其诸对立面却消失了，因为它把被设定的东西不只是与别的受限制者联系起来，而是与绝对者发生关系，并由此把它扬弃。

en: But because this relation of the limited to the absolute is a manifold, since it is the limited things that stand in it, philosophizing must set out to put this manifoldness as such into relation.
The need must arise to produce a totality of knowing, a system of science.

Only through this does the manifoldness of those relations free itself from contingency, in that they receive their places in the connection of the objective totality of knowing and their objective completeness is brought about.

Philosophizing that does not construct itself into a system is a constant flight from limitations, - more a struggle of reason for freedom than reason's pure self-cognition, which has become sure of itself and clear about itself.
Free reason and its deed are one, and its activity a pure presentation of itself.
zh: 但因为这种受限者与绝对者的关系是杂多的，既然处于这种关系中的正是那些受限者，所以哲学活动必须着手把这种杂多本身带到关系之中。
必然会产生这样一种需要：生产出一个知识的总体性，一个科学的体系。
只有通过这一点，那些关系的杂多才摆脱偶然性，因为它们在知识的客观总体性的联系中得到了自己的位置，而它们的客观完整性也被带了出来。
不把自己建构为体系的哲学活动，是一种对种种限制的不断逃避，——与其说是理性的纯粹自我认识，不如说是理性对自由的挣扎，而那种自我认识已经对自己有把握、对自己清楚了。
自由的理性与它的行动是一回事，它的活动就是纯粹地呈现它自己。

en: In this self-production of reason the absolute shapes itself into an objective totality that is carried and completed as a whole within itself, has no ground outside itself, but is grounded through itself in its beginning, middle and end.
Such a whole appears as an organization of propositions and intuitions.

Every synthesis of reason and the intuition corresponding to it, both of which are united in speculation, is as identity of the conscious and the unconscious infinite for itself in the absolute; at the same time, however, it is finite and limited insofar as it is posited in the objective totality and has others outside itself.

The most undivided identity - objectively matter, subjectively feeling (self-consciousness) - is at the same time an infinitely opposed one, a thoroughly relative identity; reason, the capacity for (objective) totality, completes it through its opposite and produces through the synthesis of both a new identity, which is itself again a deficient one before reason and which likewise again supplements itself.

Most purely does the method of the system, which is to be called neither synthetic nor analytic, give itself when it appears as a development of reason itself, which does not continually recall within itself the emanation of its appearance as a duality - thereby it would only have annihilated it -, but constructs itself in it into an identity conditioned by that duality, again opposes this relative identity to itself, so that the system goes on to completed objective totality, unites it with the opposed subjective totality into an infinite world-view, whose expansion has thereby at the same time contracted into the richest and simplest identity.
zh: 在理性的这种自我生产中，绝对者把自己形成为一个客观的总体性，这个总体性作为整体被承载于自身之内并已完成了，在自身之外没有任何根据，而是通过它自己在自己的开端、中间和终点中得到了根据。
这样一个整体显现为一种命题和直观的组织。
理性的每一个综合以及与之相应的直观，两者在思辨中是结合在一起的，这个综合作为意识与无意识的同一性，在绝对者中自为地是无限的；但同一个综合同时又是有限的、受限的，因为它被设定在客观的总体性之中，并且在自身之外还有别的综合。
最无分裂的同一性——客观上是物质，主观上是感觉（自我意识）——同时又是一种无限对立着的、完全相对的同一性；理性，即（就客观的方面而言的）总体性的能力，通过它的对立面把它补全，并通过两者的综合生产出一个新的同一性，而这个新的同一性在理性面前又是有缺陷的，同样又要再补全自己。

体系的这种既不能叫综合的、也不能叫分析的方法，最纯粹地呈现出来，是当它显现为理性自身的一种发展时：这种发展并不把它的显现之流溢作为双重性不断重新收回自身之内——那样它只会把这种显现消灭掉——，而是在这种显现中把自己建构为一个由那种双重性制约的同一性，又把这个相对的同一性重新与自己对立起来，于是体系一直前进到完成了的客观总体性，把它与那对立着的主观总体性结合为无限的世界观，而这种世界观的扩展也因此同时收缩为最丰富、最简单的同一性。

en: It is possible that a genuine speculation does not express itself completely in its system, or that the philosophy of the system and the system itself do not coincide, that a system expresses most definitely the tendency to annihilate all oppositions and for itself does not penetrate to the most complete identity.
The distinction of these two respects becomes especially important in the judging of philosophical systems.

If in a system the need lying at its basis has not completely shaped itself and it has elevated something conditioned, existing only in opposition, to the absolute, then it becomes dogmatism as a system; but true speculation can be found in the most diverse philosophies that denounce one another as dogmatisms and aberrations of spirit.
The history of philosophy alone has value and interest if it holds fast to this viewpoint.

Otherwise it gives not the history of the eternal and one reason presenting itself in infinitely manifold forms, but nothing but a narration of contingent occurrences of the human spirit and of senseless opinions that are foisted upon reason, although these fall to the charge of him alone who has not recognized the rational in them and has therefore turned them upside down.
zh: 有可能，一种真正的思辨并没有在它的体系里完全说出来，或者体系的哲学与体系本身并不重合，有可能一个体系最确定地表达出消灭一切对立的倾向，而它本身却没有穿透到最完整的同一性。
这两个着眼点的区分，在评判哲学体系时特别重要。
如果一个体系里那个作为基础的需要还没有完全成形，而它把某种有条件的、只在对立中存在的东西提高成了绝对者，那么它作为体系就成了独断论；但真正的思辨可以在极其不同的、互相指骂为独断论和精神迷误的哲学中找到自己。
哲学史只有坚守这个观点，才有价值和意义。
否则它给出的就不是那永恒而唯一的理性在无限杂多的形态中自我展现的历史，而只是一堆叙述：人类精神的偶然事件，以及被硬加给理性的无意义的意见，——而这些意见本来只该归咎于那个没有在其中认识到理性的东西、因此把它们弄颠倒了的人。

en: A genuine speculation that, however, does not penetrate to its complete self-construction in the system necessarily starts from absolute identity; the diremption of this identity into subjective and objective is a production of the absolute.
The fundamental principle is therefore wholly transcendental, and from its standpoint there is no absolute opposition of the subjective and the objective.
But thus the appearance of the absolute is an opposition; the absolute is not in its appearance; both are themselves opposed.
The appearance is not identity.

This opposition cannot be sublated transcendentally, that is, not in such a way that there would be no opposition in itself; thereby the appearance is merely annihilated, and the appearance is nevertheless also supposed to be; it would be asserted that the absolute in its appearance had gone out of itself.
The absolute must therefore posit itself in the appearance itself, that is, not annihilate it but construct it into identity.
A false identity is the causal relation between the absolute and its appearance; for this relation is grounded in the absolute opposition.
In it both opposites subsist, but in different rank; the union is forcible, the one gets the other under itself; the one rules, the other becomes subservient.
The unity is forced in a merely relative identity; the identity that is supposed to be an absolute one is an incomplete one.

The system has become a dogmatism - a realism that posits objectivity absolutely, or an idealism that posits subjectivity absolutely - against its philosophy, if both (what is more ambiguous in the former than in the latter) have emerged from true speculation.
zh: 一种真正的思辨，如果它没有穿透到自己在体系中的完整自我建构，就必然从绝对同一性出发；这种同一性分裂为主观的东西和客观的东西，是绝对者的一种生产。
所以基本原则完全是先验的，从它的立场出发，根本不存在主观的东西与客观的东西的绝对对立。
但这样一来，绝对者的显现就是一种对立；绝对者不在它的显现之中；两者本身是对立的。
显现不是同一性。
这种对立不能先验地扬弃，也就是说，不能弄成自在地根本没有对立；这样一来显现只是被消灭了，而显现毕竟也该存在；那等于断言绝对者在它的显现中走出了自身。
所以绝对者必须在显现本身中设定自己，就是说，不是消灭显现，而是把显现建构为同一性。
虚假的同一性是绝对者与其显现之间的因果关系；因为这种关系以绝对的对立为根据。
在这种关系里两个对立面都持存，但处于不同的等级；结合是强制的，一方把另一方置于自己之下；一方统治，另一方则受支配。
统一被逼成一种仅仅相对的同一性；那本该是绝对的同一性，是一种不完整的同一性。
如果两者（在前者那里比在后者那里更含混）都是从真正的思辨中产生出来的，那么体系就违背了它自己的哲学，变成了独断论——变成一种把客观性设定为绝对的实在论，或者一种把主观性设定为绝对的观念论。

en: Pure dogmatism, which is a dogmatism of philosophy, remains even in its tendency immanent in opposition; the relation of causality, in its more complete form as reciprocal action, the influence of the intellectual on the sensible or of the sensible on the intellectual, is dominant in it as fundamental principle.

In consistent realism and idealism it plays only a subordinate role, even if it seems to dominate and in the former the subject is posited as product of the object, in the latter the object as product of the subject; but the causal relation is essentially sublated, in that producing is an absolute producing and the product an absolute product, i.e. in that the product has no subsistence except in producing, is not posited as something self-dependent, subsisting before and independently of the producing, as is the case in the pure causal relation, the formal principle of dogmatism.
In dogmatism it is something posited through A and at the same time also not posited through A, A therefore absolutely only subject, and A = A expresses only the identity of the understanding.

Even if philosophy in its transcendental business makes use of the causal relation, B, which appears opposed to the subject, is according to its being-opposed a mere possibility and remains absolutely a possibility, i.e. it is only accident; and the true relation of speculation, the relation of substantiality, is under the semblance of the causal relation the transcendental principle.

Formally this can also be expressed thus: true dogmatism acknowledges both fundamental propositions A = A and A = B, but they remain side by side in their antinomy, unsynthesized; it does not recognize that an antinomy lies in this, and therefore also not the necessity of sublating the subsistence of the opposed; the transition from the one to the other through the causal relation is the only incomplete synthesis possible for it.

Although transcendental philosophy has this sharp difference from dogmatism, it is, insofar as it constructs itself into a system, capable of passing over into dogmatism, namely when - insofar as it is nothing but absolute identity and in it all difference and the subsistence of the opposed sublates itself - it admits no real causal relation, but - insofar as appearance is at the same time to subsist and thereby another relation of the absolute to appearance than that of the annihilation of the latter is to be present - introduces the causal relation, makes appearance into something subject, and thus posits transcendental intuition only subjectively, not objectively, or does not posit identity in appearance.
A = A and A = B both remain unconditioned; only A = A is to hold; but that means their identity is not presented in their true synthesis, which is no mere ought.
Thus in Fichte's system I = I is the absolute.
The totality of reason brings along the second proposition, which posits a not-I; not only is completeness present in this antinomy of the positing of both, but their synthesis is also postulated.
But in this synthesis the opposition remains; it is not both, I as well as not-I, that are to be annihilated, but the one proposition is to subsist, the one is to be higher in rank than the other.
The speculation of the system demands the sublation of the opposed, but the system itself does not sublate them; the absolute synthesis to which it attains is not I = I, but I ought to be equal to I.
The absolute is constructed for the transcendental point of view, but not for that of appearance; the two still contradict each other.

Because identity has not at the same time been posited into appearance, or identity has not also passed over completely into objectivity, the transcendental character is itself an opposed, the subjective, and one can also say that appearance has not been completely annihilated.
zh: 纯粹的独断论，即哲学上的独断论，就连在它的倾向上也仍然停留在对立之中；因果关系，在它更完整的形式即交互作用中，也就是智性的东西对感性的东西的影响，或感性的东西对智性的东西的影响，在它里面作为根本原则占统治地位。
在彻底的实在论和观念论里，它只起一种从属的作用，尽管它看起来还在支配一切，并且在前者那里主体被设定为客体的产物，在后者那里客体被设定为主体的产物；但因果关系在本质上已被扬弃，因为生产是一种绝对的生产，产物是一种绝对的产物，也就是说，因为产物只有在生产中才有持存，并没有被设定为一个独立的东西、一个在生产之前并且不依赖于生产而持存的东西，就像在纯粹的因果关系、独断论的形式原则里那样。
在独断论里，它是被 A 设定的东西，同时又不是被 A 设定的东西，所以 A 绝对只是主体，而 A = A 只表达知性同一性。
即使哲学在它的先验事务里使用了因果关系，B 这个显得与主体对立的东西，就它的被对立状态而言，也只是一种可能性，并且绝对仍然只是一种可能性，也就是说，它只是偶性；而思辨的真正关系，即实体性关系，在因果关系的假象之下，才是先验的原则。
从形式上说，这也可以这样来表达：真正的独断论承认 A = A 和 A = B 这两个根本命题，但它们仍然处在它们的二律背反里，未经综合地并排着；它没有认识到这里有一个二律背反，因而也没有认识到扬弃对立面之持存的必然性；从一个命题到另一个命题通过因果关系的那种过渡，是它唯一可能的不完全综合。

尽管先验哲学与独断论有这种尖锐的区别，但它就它把自己建构为体系而言，有可能转入独断论，即：当它——就它无非是绝对同一性、在它里面一切差别和对立面的持存都扬弃自身而言——不容许有任何实在的因果关系，却又——就现象应当同时持存，因而应当有一种绝对者与现象的关系、不同于对现象的消灭的关系而言——引入因果关系，把现象变成一种受支配的东西，从而把先验直观只设定为主观的，而不是客观的，或者说没有把同一性设定到现象里去。
A = A 和 A = B 两者都仍然是无条件的；只有 A = A 才应当有效；但这也就是说，它们的同一性并没有在它们真正的综合里被展示出来，而这种综合并不是单纯的应当。
所以在费希特体系里，我 = 我 就是绝对者。
理性的总体性带来了第二个命题，它设定一个非我；不仅在这种设定两者的二律背反里有着完整性，而且它们的综合也被要求。
但在这个综合里，对立依然存在；应当被消灭的并不是两者，即我以及非我，而是其中一个命题应当持存下来，其中一个在等级上应当高于另一个。
这个体系的思辨要求扬弃对立面，但体系本身并不扬弃它们；它达到的那种绝对综合并不是我 = 我，而是我应当等于我。
绝对者是为先验的观点、而不是为现象的观点建构起来的；两者还相互矛盾。
因为同一性没有同时被设定到现象里去，或者说同一性也没有完全过渡到客观性里去，所以先验性本身就是一种对立面，即主观的东西，而且也可以说，现象并没有被完全消灭。

en: In the following presentation of Fichte's system an attempt shall be made to show that pure consciousness, the identity of subject and object set up in the system as absolute, is a subjective identity of subject and object.

The presentation will take the course of proving the I, the principle of the system, to be a subjective subject-object, both immediately and by the manner of the deduction of nature and especially by the relations of identity in the particular sciences of morality and of natural law and by the relation of the whole system to the aesthetic.
zh: 在下面关于费希特体系的阐述中，应当尝试指出：纯粹意识，即体系中作为绝对者而树立起来的主体与客体的同一性，是一种主体与客体的主观的同一性。
这一阐述将采取这样的进路：把我，即体系的原则，证明为主观的主体—客体，既直接地证明，也依据自然的演绎方式、尤其依据道德和自然法这两门特殊科学中的同一性关系，以及整个体系对审美的东西的关系来证明。

en: It is already clear from the above that in this presentation the discussion is initially of this philosophy as system, and not insofar as it is the most thorough and deepest speculation, a genuine philosophizing, and is all the more remarkable through the time in which it appears, in which even the Kantian philosophy could not have roused reason to the lost concept of genuine speculation.
zh: 从上面已经可以清楚：在这一阐述中，首先谈的是这门哲学作为体系，而不是就它是最彻底、最深刻的思辨、是一种真正的哲学活动而言，并且由于它出现于其中的那个时代——在那个时代里，连康德哲学也未能把理性激发到那已经失落的真正思辨的概念——它才更加值得注意。

en: The foundation of Fichte's system is intellectual intuition, pure thinking of itself, pure self-consciousness I = I, I am10) ; the absolute is subject-object, and the I is this identity of subject and object.
zh: 费希特体系的基础是智性直观，是纯粹的自我思维，是纯粹自我意识 我 = 我，我是10) ；绝对者是主体—客体，而我 就是主体与客体的这种同一性。

en: In ordinary consciousness the I occurs in opposition; philosophy has to explain this opposition to an object; to explain it means to point out its being conditioned by an other and thus to prove it as appearance.

If it is proved of empirical consciousness that it is completely grounded in pure consciousness and not merely conditioned by the same, then its opposition is thereby sublated, provided the explanation is complete, that is, provided that not merely a partial identity of pure and empirical consciousness is pointed out.

The identity is only a partial one if a side were left over to empirical consciousness by which it would not be determined by the pure but would be unconditioned; and because only pure and empirical consciousness appear as the members of the highest opposition, pure consciousness itself would be determined and conditioned by the empirical, insofar as the latter would be unconditioned.

In this way the relation would be a reciprocal relation, which contains mutual determining and being determined within itself, but presupposes an absolute opposition of those standing in reciprocity and hence the impossibility of cancelling the diremption in absolute identity.
zh: 在普通意识中，我是作为对立而出现的；哲学必须解释这种对一个客体的对立；解释它就意味着指出它通过一个他者而受到的制约，从而把它证明为显现。
如果就经验意识证明了它在纯粹意识中得到了完全的根据，而不只是由纯粹意识所制约，那么它的对立就由此被扬弃了，只要这解释是完整的，也就是说，只要所指出来的不只是纯粹意识和经验意识的部分的同一性。
这种同一性就只是部分的，如果经验意识还剩下一面，在这一面上它不由纯粹意识所规定，而是无条件的；并且因为只有纯粹意识和经验意识作为最高对立的两端出现，所以纯粹意识本身就会由经验意识所规定和制约，只要经验意识是无条件的。
这样，这种关系就会是一种相互关系，它自身包含相互规定和受规定，但以处于相互作用中的双方的绝对对立为前提，因而也以不可能在绝对同一性中消除分裂为前提。

en: This pure self-consciousness arises in the philosopher by his abstracting in his thinking from everything alien that is not the I, and holding fast only to the relation of subject and object.
In empirical intuition subject and object are opposed to each other; the philosopher takes up the activity of intuiting, he intuits the intuiting and thereby conceives it as an identity.

This intuiting of intuiting is on the one hand philosophical reflection and is opposed to ordinary reflection as well as to empirical consciousness in general, which does not raise itself above itself and its oppositions; - on the other hand this transcendental intuition is at the same time the object of philosophical reflection, the absolute, the original identity.
The philosopher has raised himself into freedom and to the standpoint of the absolute.
zh: 哲学家那里的这种纯粹自我意识是这样产生的：他在自己的思维中从一切不是我的异己东西中抽象出来，只把主体和客体的关系抓住不放。
在经验直观中，主体和客体是相互对立的；哲学家把握住直观的活动，他直观这直观，并由此把它把握为一种同一性。
这种对直观的直观，一方面 是哲学反思，与普通反思以及一般经验意识相对立，后者并不把自己提升到自身及其种种对立之上；——另一方面，这种先验直观同时又是哲学反思的对象，即绝对者，本源的同一性。
哲学家已经把自己提升到自由之中，提升到绝对者的立足点上。

en: His task is now to sublate the seeming opposition of transcendental and empirical consciousness.
In general this happens by the latter being deduced from the former.

Necessarily this deduction cannot be a transition into something alien; transcendental philosophy aims solely at constructing empirical consciousness not from a principle lying outside it, but from an immanent principle, as an active emanation or self-production of the principle.
In empirical consciousness nothing can occur that is not constructed out of pure self-consciousness, any more than pure consciousness is something essentially different from the empirical.

The form of both is different precisely in this, that what in empirical consciousness appears as object, opposed to the subject, is posited as identical in the intuition of this empirical intuiting, and thereby empirical consciousness is completed through that which constitutes its essence, but of which it has no consciousness.
zh: 他现在的任务，是扬弃先验意识与经验意识那种显得存在的对立。
一般来说，这件事是这样发生的：后者从前者那里被演绎出来。
这种演绎必然不能是一种向异己东西的过渡；先验哲学所指向的只是：把经验意识不是从一个在它之外的、而是从一个内在的原则出发，建构为原则的一种能动的流溢或自我生产。
在经验意识中不可能出现任何不是从纯粹自我意识出发建构出来的东西，正如纯粹意识不可能是某种本质上不同于经验意识的东西。
两者的形式恰恰在这一点上不同：在经验意识中作为客体、与主体相对立而出现的东西，在对这种经验直观的直观中被设定为同一的，而经验意识由此就被那构成它本质的东西补全了，但它对这种东西却没有意识。

en: The task can also be expressed thus: through philosophy pure consciousness is to be sublated as concept.

In opposition to empirical consciousness, intellectual intuition, the pure thinking of itself, appears as concept, namely as abstraction from everything manifold, from all inequality of subject and object.

It is indeed nothing but activity, doing, intuiting, it exists only in the free self-activity that brings it forth; but this act, which tears itself away from everything empirical, manifold, opposed, and raises itself to the unity of thinking, I = I, identity of subject and object, has an opposition in other acts; it is to that extent capable of being determined as a concept, and has in common with those opposed to it a higher sphere, that of thinking in general.
Besides the thinking of itself there is still other thinking, besides self-consciousness still manifold empirical consciousness, besides the I as object still manifold objects of consciousness.
The act of self-consciousness is definitely distinguished from other consciousness by the fact that its object is equal to the subject; I = I is to that extent opposed to an infinite objective world.
zh: 这项任务也可以这样来表达：通过哲学，纯粹意识应当作为概念而被扬弃。
在与经验意识的对立中，智性直观，即纯粹的自我思维，表现为概念，即表现为对一切杂多、对主体与客体的一切不等同的抽象。
它固然纯粹是活动、作为、直观，它只存在于把它产生出来的自由的自发活动之中；但这个行动，这个从一切经验的、杂多的、对立的东西中挣脱出来、把自己提升到思维的统一性、我 = 我、主体与客体的同一性的行动，却在另一些行动那里有一种对立；就此而言，它能够被规定为一个概念，并且与那些和它对立的行动共有一个更高的领域，即一般思维的领域。
除了自我思维，还有别的思维；除了自我意识，还有杂多的经验意识；除了作为客体的我，还有意识的杂多客体。
自我意识的活动明确地不同于别的意识，因为它的对象与主体相等；就此而言，我 = 我 是与一个无限的客观世界相对立的。

en: In this way no philosophical knowledge has come about through transcendental intuition; on the contrary, if reflection takes possession of it, sets it against other intuition and holds fast to this opposition, then no philosophical knowledge is possible.

This absolute act of free self-activity is the condition of philosophical knowledge, but it is not yet philosophy itself; through philosophy the objective totality of empirical knowledge is equated with pure self-consciousness, the latter thereby being wholly sublated as concept or as the opposed, and with it the former as well.

It is asserted that there is only pure consciousness at all, I = I is the absolute; all empirical consciousness would be only a pure product of I = I, and empirical consciousness would to that extent be wholly denied, insofar as an absolute twoness should be in it or through it, a being-posited should occur in it that was not a being-posited of the I for the I and through the I.

With the self-positing of the I everything would be posited, and nothing besides it; the identity of pure and empirical consciousness is not an abstraction from their original opposition, but on the contrary, their opposition is an abstraction from their original identity.
zh: 这样一来，通过先验直观并没有产生任何哲学知识；相反，如果反思占有了它，把它与别的直观对立起来并固守住这种对立，那么任何哲学知识都不可能。
这种自由的自发活动的绝对行动是哲学知识的条件，但它还不是哲学本身；通过哲学，经验知识的客观总体性被等同于纯粹自我意识，后者由此完全作为概念或作为对立面而被扬弃，前者也随之被扬弃。
有人断言，根本说来只存在纯粹意识，我 = 我 就是绝对者；一切经验意识都只是我 = 我 的纯粹产物，而经验意识就会因此被完全否定，因为在它之中或通过它应当有一种绝对的二重性，应当出现一种被设定状态，而这种被设定状态并不是我为我、并且通过我而作的被设定状态。
随着我的自我设定，一切都已被设定，除此之外别无他物；纯粹意识与经验意识的同一性并不是从它们原初的对立中抽象出来的，相反，它们的对立才是从它们原初的同一性中抽象出来的。

en: Intellectual intuition is thereby posited as equal to everything, it is the totality.

This being-identical of all empirical consciousness with the pure is knowledge, and the philosophy that knows this being-identical is the science of knowledge11); it has to show the manifoldness of empirical consciousness as identical with the pure through the deed, through the actual development of the objective out of the I, and to describe the totality of empirical consciousness as the objective totality of self-consciousness; in I = I the whole manifoldness of knowledge is given to it.

To mere reflection this deduction appears as the contradictory undertaking of deriving manifoldness from unity, twoness from pure identity; but the identity of I = I is no pure identity, i.e. none that has arisen through the abstracting of reflection.
If reflection conceives I = I as unity, it must at the same time also conceive it as twoness; I = I is identity and duplicity at once, it is an opposition within I = I.
The I is at one time subject, at another object; but what is opposed to the I is likewise I; the opposed are identical.

Empirical consciousness can therefore not be regarded as a going-out from the pure; on this view a science of knowledge that starts from pure consciousness would of course be something absurd; the view as if in empirical consciousness a stepping-out from the pure took place has the above abstraction as its ground, in which reflection isolates its opposing.

Reflection as understanding is in and for itself incapable of grasping transcendental intuition; and even if reason has penetrated to self-cognition, reflection, wherever room is given it, turns the rational back into something opposed.
zh: 智性直观由此被设定为等同于一切，它就是总体性。
一切经验意识与纯粹意识的这种同一存在就是知识，而知道这种同一存在的哲学就是关于知识的科学11)；它必须通过行动、通过客观东西从我的现实发展，来指明经验意识的杂多与纯粹意识是同一的，并把经验意识的总体性描述为自我意识的客观总体性；在我 = 我 之中，知识的全部杂多都已经给予了它。
在单纯反思看来，这种演绎是从统一中引出杂多、从纯粹同一性中引出二重性的自相矛盾的做法；但我 = 我 的同一性并不是纯粹的同一性，也就是说，并不是通过反思的抽象而产生的那种同一性。
如果反思把我 = 我 以概念把握为统一，它就必须同时把它也以概念把握为二重性；我 = 我 同时是同一性和双重性，在我 = 我 之中有一种对立。
我 一次是主体，另一次是客体；但与我对立的东西同样也是我；对立的两者是同一的。
因此不能把经验意识看作从纯粹意识中走出来；按照这种看法，一门从纯粹意识出发的关于知识的科学当然就是荒谬的东西；那种认为在经验意识中已经走出了纯粹意识的看法，其根据就是上面所说的抽象，反思在这种抽象中把它的对立设定孤立起来。
作为知性的反思自在自为地无力把握先验直观；而即使理性已经进展到自我认识，只要给了反思空间，它就把理性的东西又重新颠倒成对立的东西。

en: So far we have described the purely transcendental side of the system, in which reflection has no power, but through reason the task of philosophy has been determined and described.

Because of this genuinely transcendental side, the other side, in which reflection rules, is all the harder both to grasp as regards its starting point and to hold fast at all, because for the understanding, into which reflection has turned the rational, the retreat to the transcendental side always remains open.

It is therefore to be shown that the two standpoints, that of speculation and that of reflection, essentially belong to this system, and indeed in such a way that the latter does not have a subordinate place, but that they are absolutely necessary at the centre of the system and are ununited. - Or: I = I is the absolute principle of speculation, but this identity is not exhibited by the system; the objective I does not become equal to the subjective I, both remain absolutely opposed to each other.
The I does not find itself in its appearance or in its positing; in order to find itself as I, it must annihilate its appearance.
The essence of the I and its positing do not coincide: the I does not become objective to itself.
zh: 到此为止我们描述的是这个体系的纯粹先验的方面，在这个方面反思没有任何力量，反倒是理性规定并描述了哲学的任务。
由于这个真正先验的方面，反思在其中占统治地位的那个方面就更难按其起点去把握、甚至根本无法固守，因为对于知性的东西——反思把理性的东西颠倒成了这种东西——来说，退回到先验方面的路始终是敞开的。
因此必须指明，两个立场，即思辨的立场和反思的立场，本质上都属于这个体系，而且后者并不处于从属的位置，相反，它们在体系的中心是绝对必然的，并且是未被统一起来的。——或者：我 = 我 是思辨的绝对原则，但这个体系并没有把这种同一性展示出来；客观的我并不等同于主观的我，两者始终绝对地相互对立。
我 在它的现象中、在它的设定中找不到自己；为了把自己作为我来找到，它必须消灭自己的现象。
我 的本质和它的设定并不重合：我 并不对自己成为客观的。

en: In the Doctrine of Science Fichte chose, for the presentation of the principle of his system, the form of fundamental propositions, whose inconvenience was spoken of above.

The first fundamental proposition is the absolute self-positing of the I, the I as infinite positing; the second is absolute counter-positing or positing of an infinite not-I; the third is the absolute unification of the first two through absolute division of the I and the not-I, and a distribution of the infinite sphere to a divisible I and to a divisible not-I.
These three absolute fundamental propositions present three absolute acts of the I.

From this plurality of absolute acts it follows immediately that these acts and the fundamental propositions are only relative, or, insofar as they enter into the construction of the totality of consciousness, only ideal factors.

In this position, in which it is opposed to other absolute acts, I = I has only the meaning of pure self-consciousness, insofar as this is opposed to the empirical; as such it is conditioned by the abstraction from the empirical, and just as certainly as the second fundamental proposition and the third are conditioned, so certainly is the first fundamental proposition too; already the plurality of absolute acts points immediately to this, even if their content is quite unknown.

It is not at all necessary that I = I, the absolute self-positing, be conceived as something conditioned; on the contrary, we saw it above in its transcendental meaning as absolute (not merely understanding-) identity.

But in this form, in which I = I is set up as one among several fundamental propositions, it has no other meaning than that of pure self-consciousness, which is opposed to the empirical, and that of philosophical reflection, which is opposed to the common one.
zh: 费希特在《知识学》中为了陈述他体系的原则，选择了根本命题的形式，上面已经谈到这种形式的不便。
第一个根本命题是我的绝对的自我设定，即我作为无限的设定；第二个是绝对的对面设定，或对一个无限的非我的设定；第三个是通过对我与非我的绝对分割而对前两个命题的绝对统一，以及把无限的范围分配给一个可分的我和一个可分的非我。
这三个绝对的根本命题表述了我的三个绝对行动。
从这种绝对行动的多数性直接得出：这些行动和这些根本命题只是相对的，或者，就它们进入意识的总体性的建构而言，只是观念的要素。
我 = 我 在这种位置中，即它被与其他绝对行动对立起来的位置中，只有纯粹自我意识的意义，因为纯粹自我意识是与经验意识相对立的；它作为这样的东西，是由对经验东西的抽象所制约的，而第二个根本命题和第三个根本命题有多少是被制约的，第一个根本命题也就有多少是被制约的；单是绝对行动的多数性就已经直接指向这一点，即使这些行动的内容还完全不为人知。
完全没有必要把我 = 我、即绝对的自我设定，理解为一种被制约的东西；相反，我们在上面已经就它的先验意义把它看作绝对的（不只是知性的）同一性。
但在这种形式下，即我 = 我 被作为多个根本命题中的一个而提出来时，它除了纯粹自我意识的意义——纯粹自我意识与经验意识相对立——和哲学反思的意义——哲学反思与普通反思相对立——之外，没有别的意义。

en: But these ideal factors of pure positing and pure counter-positing could be posited only for the sake of philosophical reflection, which, although it starts from the original identity, precisely (in order to describe the true essence of this identity) begins with the presentation of things absolutely opposed and combines them into an antinomy, - the only way in which reflection can present the absolute, in order to remove absolute identity at once from the sphere of concepts and to constitute it as an identity that does not abstract from subject and object, but as an identity of subject and object.

This identity cannot be conceived in such a way that pure self-positing and pure counter-positing are both activities of one and the very same I; such an identity would not be a transcendental one at all, but a transcendent one; the absolute contradiction of the opposed should subsist, the unification of both would reduce itself to a unification in the general concept of activity.
A transcendental unification is demanded, in which the contradiction of both activities is itself sublated and out of the ideal factors a true synthesis, at once ideal and real, is constructed.

The third fundamental proposition gives this: in the I, the I opposes to the divisible I a divisible not-I.12) The infinite objective sphere, the opposed, is neither absolute I nor absolute not-I, but that which encloses the opposed, that which is filled by opposed factors that stand in the relation that, as much as the one is posited, so much the other is not, - insofar as the one rises, the other falls.
zh: 但纯粹设定和纯粹对面设定的这些观念的要素，只能是为了哲学反思的缘故才被设定，这种反思虽然从原初的同一性出发，却恰好（为了描述这种同一性的真正本质）从陈述绝对对立的东西开始，并把它们结合成二律背反，——这是反思陈述绝对者的唯一方式，以便立刻把绝对同一性从概念的领域里拿开，并把它构成这样一种同一性：它不是从主体和客体中抽象出来的，而是主体和客体的同一性。
不能这样来理解这种同一性，仿佛纯粹自我设定和纯粹对面设定是同一个我的两种活动；这样一种同一性绝不是先验的同一性，而是超验的同一性；对立面的绝对矛盾应当持续存在，两者的统一就只会归结为在活动这一普遍概念中的统一。
这里要求一种先验的统一，在其中两种活动的矛盾本身被扬弃，并且从观念的要素中建构出一种真实的、同时既是观念的又是实在的综合。
第三个根本命题给出的就是这种统一：我 在 我 之中把可分的非我与可分的我 对立起来。12) 无限客观的领域，即对立面，既不是绝对的我，也不是绝对的非我，而是把对立的两者包括起来的东西，是由对立的各个方面所充满的东西，这些方面处于这样的关系中：一方面被设定了多少，另一方面就没有多少，——一方面上升，另一方面就下降。

en: In this synthesis, however, the objective I is not equal to the subjective; the subjective is I, the objective is I + not-I.
In it the original identity does not present itself; pure consciousness I = I and the empirical I = I + not-I, with all the forms in which this latter constructs itself, remain opposed to each other.
The incompleteness of this synthesis, which the third fundamental proposition expresses, is necessary, if the acts of the first and second fundamental propositions are absolutely opposed activities.
Or at bottom no synthesis at all is possible; synthesis is possible only then, when the activities of self-positing and of opposing are posited as ideal factors.

It does indeed seem to contradict itself that activities which are to be absolutely no concepts should be treated only as ideal factors; [but] whether I and not-I, subjective and objective, the ones to be united, are expressed as activities (positing and opposing) or as products (objective I and not-I), makes in itself, and also for a system whose principle is identity, no difference.
Their character of being absolutely opposed makes them purely and simply something merely ideal, and Fichte acknowledges this pure ideality of theirs.

For him the opposed are before the synthesis something quite different from after the synthesis: before the synthesis they are merely opposed and nothing further; the one is what the other is not, and the other what the one is not, - a mere thought without any reality, and moreover a thought of mere reality; as soon as the one enters, the other is annihilated; but since this one can enter only under the predicate of the opposite of the other, and consequently with its concept the concept of the other enters at the same time and annihilates it, this one itself cannot enter.

Hence nothing at all is present, and it was only a beneficent deception of the imagination that imperceptibly substituted a substratum for those merely opposed, and made it possible to think about them.13) - From the ideality of the opposed factors it follows that they are nothing except in the synthetic activity, that through this alone their being-opposed and they themselves are posited, and that their opposition has been used only for the sake of the philosophical construction, in order to make the synthetic capacity intelligible.

The productive imagination would be the absolute identity itself, represented as activity, which, only in that it posits the product, the limit, at the same time posits the opposed as the limiting ones.

That the productive imagination appears as synthetic capacity, which is conditioned by the opposed, would hold only for the standpoint of reflection, which starts from the opposed and comprehends intuition only as a unification of them.

At the same time, however, philosophical reflection, in order to designate this view as a subjective one belonging to reflection, would have to establish the transcendental standpoint by cognizing those absolutely opposed activities as nothing other than ideal factors, as thoroughly relative identities with regard to the absolute identity, in which empirical consciousness no less than its opposite, pure consciousness, are sublated, - pure consciousness which, as abstraction from the former, has an opposite on it.
Only in this sense is I the transcendental midpoint of both opposed activities and indifferent toward both; their absolute opposition has a meaning solely for their ideality.
zh: 但在这个综合里，客观的我并不等于主观的我；主观的我就是我，客观的我则是我 + 非我。
在它之中并不显现出本原的同一性；纯粹意识 我 = 我 与经验的我 = 我 + 非我，连同后者借以建构自己的所有形式，仍然彼此对立。
这种综合的不完整，也就是第三个根本命题所道出的不完整，是必然的，如果第一和第二个根本命题的行动是绝对对立的活动的话。
或者根本上根本不可能有综合；综合只有在把自我设定与建立对立这两种活动设定为观念的因素时才是可能的。
说那些绝对不该是概念的活动只能被当作观念的因素来处理，这看起来确实自相矛盾；但不管我与非我、主观的东西与客观的东西这些有待联合者，是被表达为活动（设定与建立对立），还是被表达为产物（客观的我与非我），这自在地并不构成任何差别，对一个其原则是同一性的体系来说也一样。
它们绝对对立这一特征使它们干脆成了单纯的观念物，而费希特也承认它们这种纯粹的观念性。
在他看来，对立面在综合之前与在综合之后完全是两回事：在综合之前，它们只是对立面，此外什么也不是；一方是另一方所不是的东西，另一方是一方所不是的东西，——一个没有任何实在性的单纯思想，而且还是一个关于单纯实在性的思想；一方一出现，另一方就被消灭了；但既然这一方只能在对另一方的对立这一谓词下出现，因而随着它的概念，另一方的概念也同时出现并把它消灭，那么这一方自己也就不能出现。
因此根本什么都没有，那只是想象力的一次善意欺骗，它不知不觉地给那些单纯的对立面塞进了一个基底，使人们有可能对它们进行思考。13) ——从对立因素的观念性可以得出：它们只是在综合活动之中才存在，只有通过这种活动，它们的对立和它们本身才被设定，而它们的对立之被使用，只是为了哲学建构，为了使综合的能力变得可以理解。
生产性的想象力就会是绝对同一性本身，被表象为活动，而它只有在设定产物即界限时，才同时把对立面设定为进行限制的东西。
生产性的想象力作为由对立面所制约的综合能力而出现，这一点只会对反思的立场有效，这种立场从对立面出发，把直观只理解为对立面的一种联合。
但同时，哲学反思为了把这种看法标认为一种主观的、属于反思的看法，就必须建立起先验的立场，其方式是把那些绝对对立的活动认作无非是观念的因素，认作相对于绝对同一性而言完全相对的同一性，而在这种绝对同一性里，经验的意识与它的对立面即纯粹意识同样被扬弃了，纯粹意识作为对经验意识的抽象，在经验意识身上有一个对立面。
只有在这个意义上，我才是两种对立活动的先验中心点，并对两者无差别；它们的绝对对立只对它们的观念性才有意义。

en: But already the imperfection of the synthesis, which is expressed in the third fundamental proposition and in which the objective I is an I + not-I, awakens in itself the suspicion that the opposed activities should not count merely as relative identities, as ideal factors, for which one could take them if one looked merely at their relation to the synthesis and abstracted from the title of absoluteness which both activities bear just as the third does.
zh: 但单是这种综合的不完整，也就是在第三个根本命题中被表达出来、并且其中客观的我是一个我 + 非我 的那种不完整，本身就已经引起了这样的怀疑：那些对立的活动不该只被看作相对的同一性、看作观念的因素；人们本来倒可以那样看待它们，只要人们只着眼于它们与综合的关系，并从两种活动同第三个命题一样带有的绝对性这一称号中抽象出来。

en: But self-positing and opposing are not to enter into this relation among themselves and toward the synthetic activities.
I = I is absolute activity, which in no respect is to be considered as relative identity and as ideal factor.
For this I = I a not-I is something absolutely opposed; but their unification is necessary and the sole interest of speculation.
But what unification is possible on the presupposition of things absolutely opposed?

Evidently properly none at all; or - since the absoluteness of their opposition must at least in part be given up and the third fundamental proposition must necessarily enter, while the opposition nonetheless lies at the ground - only a partial identity.
Absolute identity is indeed the principle of speculation, but it remains, like its expression 'I = I', only the rule whose infinite fulfilment is postulated but not constructed in the system.
zh: 但自我设定和建立对立不该进入它们彼此之间以及它们对综合活动的这种关系。
我 = 我 是绝对的活动，它在任何方面都不该被看作相对的同一性和观念的因素。
对这个 我 = 我 来说，一个非我是绝对对立的东西；但它们的联合是必然的，并且是思辨唯一的旨趣。
但在以绝对对立的东西为前提的情况下，什么样的联合才是可能的？
显然其实根本没有；或者——因为至少部分地必须离开它们对立的绝对性，第三个根本命题必然要介入，而对立本身又作为根据放在底下——只有一种部分的同一性。
绝对同一性固然是思辨的原则，但它就像它的表达“我 = 我”一样，仍然只是规则，它的无限充实被要求着，在体系中却没有被建构出来。

en: The main point must be to prove that self-positing and opposing are absolutely opposed activities in the system.
Fichte's words indeed state this directly; but this absolute opposition is supposed to be precisely the condition under which the productive imagination alone is possible.

But the productive imagination is I only as theoretical capacity, which cannot raise itself above the opposition; for practical capacity the opposition falls away, and it is practical capacity alone that sublates it.

It is accordingly to be proved that even for this the opposition is absolute, and that even in practical capacity I does not posit itself as I, but the objective I is likewise an I + not-I, and practical capacity does not penetrate through to I = I.
Conversely, the absoluteness of the opposition follows from the incompleteness of the highest synthesis of the system, in which it is still present.
zh: 主要的一点必须是证明：自我设定与建立对立在体系中是绝对对立的活动。
费希特的话确实直接说出了这一点；但这种绝对对立恰恰应当成为那个条件，唯有在它之下，生产性的想象力才可能。
但生产性的想象力只有作为理论的能力才是我，这种能力不能把自己提高到对立之上；对实践的能力来说，对立消失了，而唯有实践的能力才扬弃它。
因此必须证明：对这种能力来说对立也是绝对的，而且即使在实践的能力中，我也不作为我而设定自己，客观的我同样是一个我 + 非我，实践的能力也达不到 我 = 我。
反过来，对立的绝对性从体系最高综合的不完整中得出，在这种综合里它仍然存在着。

en: Dogmatic idealism preserves for itself the unity of the principle by denying the object altogether and positing one of the opposed, the subject in its determinacy, as the absolute, just as dogmatism, in its purity materialism, denies the subjective.

If the need that lies at the ground of philosophizing is only for such an identity as is to be brought about by denying one of the opposed and abstracting absolutely from it, then it is indifferent which of the two, the subjective or the objective, is denied.

Their opposition is in consciousness, and the reality of the one is grounded in it just as much as the reality of the other; pure consciousness can be demonstrated in the empirical no more and no less than the dogmatist's thing-in-itself.

Neither the subjective nor the objective alone fills out consciousness; the purely subjective is an abstraction just as much as the purely objective; dogmatic idealism posits the subjective as the real ground of the objective, dogmatic realism the objective as the real ground of the subjective.
Consistent realism denies consciousness altogether as a self-activity of self-positing.

But even if his object, which he posits as the real ground of consciousness, is expressed as not-I = not-I, if he points out the reality of his object in consciousness, and thus the identity of consciousness is asserted to him as something absolute against his objective stringing of the finite onto the finite, then he must indeed give up the form of his principle of a pure objectivity.
As soon as he admits a thinking, I = I is to be exhibited from the analysis of thinking.
It is thinking expressed as proposition; for thinking is the self-active relating of the opposed, and the relating is to posit the opposed as equal.
But just as idealism asserts the unity of consciousness, so realism can assert its two-ness.

The unity of consciousness presupposes a two-ness, the relating a being-opposed; over against I = I stands another proposition just as absolutely: the subject is not equal to the object; both propositions are of equal rank.

But however much some forms in which Fichte has presented his system might tempt one to take it as a system of dogmatic idealism which denies the principle opposed to it - as indeed Reinhold overlooks the transcendental significance of Fichte's principle, according to which in I = I the difference of subject and object is at the same time demanded to be posited, and sees in Fichte's system a system of absolute subjectivity, i.e. a dogmatic idealism14) -, Fichte's idealism is distinguished precisely by this, that the identity which it sets up does not deny the objective, but posits the subjective and objective on equal rank of reality and certainty, - and pure and empirical consciousness are one.

For the sake of the identity of subject and object I posit things outside me just as certainly as I posit myself; as certainly as I am, the things are. - But if I posits only things or only itself, only one of the two or else both at once but separate, then in the system I will not itself become subject = object.
The subjective is indeed subject = object, but the objective is not, and hence not subject equal to object.
zh: 独断的观念论为自己保住原则的统一性，靠的是根本否认客体，并把对立面之一、即在其规定性中的主体设定为绝对者，正如独断论——在其纯粹形态中就是唯物论——否认主观的东西。
如果哲学活动底下的需要只是一种这样的同一性，它要靠否认对立面之一、并从那一个方面绝对抽象出来才产生，那么被否认的是两者中的哪一个、是主观的东西还是客观的东西，就无所谓了。
它们的对立就在意识之中，一方的实在性和另一方的实在性都在意识中得到同样充分的根据；纯粹意识能在经验的意识中被指证出来的程度，并不比独断论者的物自体多，也不比它少。
单是主观的东西、或单是客观的东西，都填不满意识；纯粹主观的东西和纯粹客观的东西一样是抽象；独断的观念论把主观的东西设定为客观的东西的实在根据，独断的实在论则把客观的东西设定为主观的东西的实在根据。
一贯的实在论根本否认意识是自我设定的一种自我活动。
但即使他所设定为意识之实在根据的那个客体被表达为非我 = 非我，即使他指证出他的客体在意识中的实在性，因而意识的同一性作为某种绝对的东西被提出来，与他那种把有限者一个接一个串在有限者上的客观做法相对抗，他也确实必须放弃他那条纯粹客观性的原则的形式。
他一旦承认有思维，就必须从对思维的分析中把 我 = 我 展示出来。
它就是被表达为命题的思维；因为思维是自我活动地把对立面关联起来，而关联就是把对立面设定为相等。
但正如观念论主张意识的统一性，实在论也可以主张意识的二重性。
意识的统一性预设了一种二重性，关联则预设了一种对立状态；与 我 = 我 相对，另有一个命题同样绝对地立在那里：主体不等于客体；两个命题地位相同。

费希特表述他的体系时所采用的某些形式，可能很容易诱使人把它当成一个独断的观念论体系，这种观念论否认与它相对立的那条原则——赖因霍尔德就是这样，他忽视了费希特原则的先验含义，按照这种含义，在 我 = 我 中同时要求设定主体与客体的差别，而他却在费希特的体系中看到了一种绝对主体性的体系，也就是一种独断的观念论14)——，但费希特的观念论恰恰由此而区别开来：它所提出的同一性并不否认客观的东西，而是把主观的东西和客观的东西放在实在性与确定性的同等地位上，——并且纯粹意识和经验意识是一回事。
为了主体与客体的同一性，我设定我之外的物，其确定程度与我设定自己一样；我有多么确定地存在，物也就存在。——但如果我只设定物、或只设定自己，只设定两者之一，或者虽然同时设定两者却把它们分开，那么我在体系中就不会自己成为主体 = 客体。
主观的东西固然是主体 = 客体，但客观的东西不是，因此也不是主体等于客体。

en: As theoretical faculty, the I is unable to posit itself completely objectively and to come out of the opposition.
"The I posits itself as determined by the not-I"15) is that part of the third fundamental proposition through which the I constitutes itself as intelligence.

Even if the objective world now proves to be an accident of the intelligence, and the not-I, whereby the intelligence posits itself as determinate, is something indeterminate, and every determination of it is a product of the intelligence, yet one side of the theoretical faculty still remains, by which it is conditioned; namely, the objective world, in its infinite determinacy through the intelligence, remains at the same time always a something for the intelligence that is at the same time indeterminate for it.

The not-I has indeed no positive character, but it has the negative one, that of being an other, i.e. something opposed in general; - or, as Fichte expresses himself: the intelligence is conditioned by a check, which however is in itself through and through indeterminate.16)

Since not-I expresses only the negative, something indeterminate, this character itself belongs to it only through a positing of the I: the I posits itself as not posited; the opposing in general, the positing of something absolutely undetermined by the I, is itself a positing of the I.
In this turn the immanence of the I, even as intelligence, is asserted with respect to its being conditioned by an other, = X.

But the contradiction has only received another form, through which it has itself become immanent: namely, the opposing of the I and the self-positing of the I contradict each other; and out of this opposition the theoretical faculty cannot come; it therefore remains absolute for it.
The productive imagination is a hovering between absolutely opposed things, which it synthesizes only in the limit, but whose opposed ends it cannot unite.
zh: 我作为理论能力，不能把自己完全客观地设定起来，也不能从对立中走出来。
“我把自己设定为被非我规定的”15)是第三条根本命题中的那一个部分，我通过这个部分把自己构造为智性。
即使客观世界表明为智性的一个偶性，并且智性借以把自己设定为有规定的那个非我是一个无规定的东西、它的每一种规定都是智性的产物，理论能力却仍然剩下一个方面，它是受这个方面制约的；也就是说，客观世界在其通过智性而获得的无限规定性中，对智性来说始终同时是一个某物，而这个某物对智性来说同时又是无规定的。
非我固然没有肯定的性质，却具有否定的性质，即一般地是一个他者、一个对立面；——或者像费希特所表述的那样：智性是由一种阻抗制约的，而这种阻抗本身却完全是无规定的16)。
既然非我表达的只是否定的东西、一个无规定的东西，那么这种性质本身也只有通过我的一种设定才属于非我：我把自己设定为没有被设定；一般地树立对立，即设定一个绝对不由我规定的东西，本身就是我的一种设定。
在这一转折里，我的内在性，即使作为智性，就它受一个他者、即 = X 的制约而言，也被主张下来。
但矛盾只是获得了另一种形式，它本身借此变成了内在的：也就是说，我的树立对立和我的自我设定互相矛盾；而理论能力无法从这种对立中走出来；因此这种对立对理论能力来说仍然是绝对的。
生产性的想象力是一种在绝对对立者之间的飘浮，它只能在界限中把这些绝对对立者综合起来，却不能把它们对立的两端统一起来。

en: Through the theoretical faculty the I does not become objective to itself; instead of penetrating through to I = I, the object arises for it as I + not-I; or, pure consciousness does not prove equal to empirical consciousness.
zh: 通过理论能力，我并没有对自己成为客观的；它没有贯通到 我 = 我，反而产生了作为 我 + 非我 的客体；或者说，纯粹意识并不表明自己等同于经验意识。

en: From this there results the character of the transcendental deduction of an objective world.

I = I as principle of speculation or of subjective philosophical reflection, which is opposed to empirical consciousness, has to prove itself objectively as principle of philosophy by sublating the opposition to empirical consciousness.

This must happen if pure consciousness produces out of itself a manifoldness of activities equal to the manifoldness of empirical consciousness; thereby I = I would prove itself the immanent real ground of the totality of the being-outside-one-another of objectivity.
But in empirical consciousness there is something opposed, an X, which pure consciousness, because it is a self-positing, can neither produce out of itself nor overcome, but must presuppose.

The question is whether absolute identity cannot also, insofar as it appears as theoretical faculty, abstract entirely from subjectivity and from the opposition to empirical consciousness and, within this sphere, become objective to itself, A = A.

But this theoretical faculty, as the I that posits itself as I, determined by the not-I, is in general no pure immanent sphere; even within it every product of the I is at the same time something not determined by the I; pure consciousness, insofar as it produces the manifoldness of empirical consciousness out of itself, therefore appears with the character of defectiveness.
This original defectiveness of it constitutes therefore the possibility of a deduction of the objective world in general, and the subjective element in it appears most clearly in this deduction.
The I posits an objective world because, insofar as it posits itself, it cognizes itself as defective; and with that the absoluteness of pure consciousness falls away.
The objective world acquires the relation to self-consciousness that it becomes a condition of the same.

Pure consciousness and empirical consciousness condition each other, the one is as necessary as the other; in Fichte's phrase17), progress is made to empirical consciousness because pure consciousness is not a complete consciousness. - In this reciprocal relation their absolute opposition remains; the identity that can take place is a most incomplete and superficial one; another is necessary, which comprises pure and empirical consciousness within itself, but sublates both as what they are.
zh: 由此得出对一个客观世界的先验演绎具有怎样的性质。
我 = 我作为思辨的原则，或作为与经验意识相对立的主观哲学反思的原则，必须通过扬弃与经验意识的对立，来把自己客观地证明为哲学的原则。
如果纯粹意识从自身中生产出一种与经验意识的杂多相等的活动的杂多，这件事就必须发生；由此我 = 我 就会把自己证明为客观性的彼此外在这一总体性的内在实在根据。
但在经验意识里有某个对立的东西，一个 X；纯粹意识因为是一种自我设定，既不能把它从自身中生产出来，也不能克服它，而必须把它预设起来。
问题在于，绝对同一性是否也不能，就它作为理论能力而出现而言，完全从主体性、从与经验意识的对立中抽象出来，并在这个领域之内使自己成为客观的，即 A = A。
但这种理论能力，作为把自己设定为我、并被非我规定的我，根本不是一个纯粹内在的领域；即使在它之内，我的每一个产物同时也是一个不由我规定的东西；纯粹意识，就它从自身中生产出经验意识的杂多而言，因此显得带有缺陷的性质。
纯粹意识这种原初的缺陷因此构成了对客观世界一般地进行演绎的可能性，而纯粹意识中主观的东西在这种演绎里最清楚地显露出来。
我设定一个客观世界，因为就它设定自己而言，它认识到自己是有缺陷的；纯粹意识的绝对性也随之消失。
客观世界对自我意识取得这样一种关系：它成为自我意识的一个条件。
纯粹意识和经验意识互相制约，一方和另一方同样必然；用费希特的说法17)，之所以前进到经验意识，是因为纯粹意识不是一种完整的意识。——在这种交互关系里，它们的绝对对立依然存在；能够出现的那种同一性是极不完整、极为表面的；必然需要另一种同一性，它把纯粹意识和经验意识都包含在自身之内，却把两者都作为它们所是的东西加以扬弃。

en: The form which the objective (or nature) receives through this kind of deduction will be discussed below.

But the subjectivity of pure consciousness, which results from the form of deduction discussed, gives us information about another form of it, in which the production of the objective is a pure act of free activity.

If self-consciousness is conditioned by empirical consciousness, then empirical consciousness cannot be a product of absolute freedom, and the free activity of the I would become only a factor in the construction of the intuition of an objective world.

That the world is a product of the freedom of the intelligence is the distinctly expressed principle of idealism, and if the Fichtean idealism has not constructed this principle into a system, the reason for this will be found in the character in which freedom appears in this system.
zh: 客观的东西（或者自然）通过这种演绎所获得的形式，下面会谈到。
但纯粹意识的主观性——它是从上面讨论的那种演绎形式中得出的——使我们了解到演绎的另一种形式，在其中，客观的东西的生产是自由活动的一个纯粹行动。
如果自我意识受经验意识制约，那么经验意识就不可能是绝对自由的产物，而我的自由活动就会只是建构一个客观世界的直观时的一个因素。
世界是智性自由的产物，这是观念论明确说出的原则；而如果费希特的观念论没有把这一原则建构为一个体系，那么其原因要到自由在这个体系中出现时所具有的特性中去找。

en: Philosophical reflection is an act of absolute freedom; it raises itself with absolute arbitrariness out of the sphere of being-given and produces with consciousness what in empirical consciousness the intelligence produces unconsciously and what therefore appears as given.

In the sense in which the manifoldness of necessary representations arises for philosophical reflection as a system brought forth through freedom, the unconscious production of an objective world is not asserted as an act of freedom - for in this respect empirical and philosophical consciousness are opposed - but insofar as both are the identity of self-positing; self-positing, the identity of subject and object, is free activity.

In the previous presentation of the production of the objective world out of pure consciousness or self-positing, an absolute opposing necessarily came in; this, insofar as the objective world is to be deduced as an act of freedom, comes to appearance as a self-limiting of the I through itself, and the productive imagination is constructed out of the factors of the indeterminate activity going into the infinite, and of the limiting activity going towards finitization.

If the reflecting activity is likewise posited as an infinite one, as it must be posited because here it is an ideal factor, something absolutely opposed, then it too can be posited as an act of freedom, and the I limits itself with freedom.

In this way freedom and limit would not stand opposed to each other, but would posit themselves infinitely - and finitely: the same thing that came up above as the opposition of the first and second fundamental proposition.

The limitation is hereby indeed something immanent, for it is the I that limits itself; the objects are posited only in order to explain this limitation, and the self-limiting of the intelligence is the only real thing.

In this way the absolute opposition which empirical consciousness sets between subject and object is sublated, but it is carried over in another form into the intelligence itself; and the intelligence finds itself enclosed in incomprehensible limits, it is its absolutely incomprehensible law to limit itself; but precisely the incomprehensibility of the opposition of ordinary consciousness for it is what drives to speculation.

But the incomprehensibility remains in the system through the limit posited into the intelligence itself, to break through whose circle is the sole interest of the need of philosophy. - If freedom is opposed to the limiting activity, as self-positing to opposing, then freedom is conditioned, which it should not be; if the limiting activity is also posited as an activity of freedom - as above self-positing and opposing were both posited into the I -, then freedom is absolute identity, but it contradicts its appearance, which is always something non-identical, finite and unfree.

Freedom does not succeed in the system in producing itself; the product does not correspond to what produces; the system that starts from self-positing leads the intelligence to its conditioned condition into an endlessness of finitudes, without restoring it in them and out of them.
zh: 哲学反思是绝对自由的一个行动，它以绝对的任意从被给予性的范围中升起，并且有意识地生产出在经验意识中智性无意识地生产、因而显得是被给予的东西。
在哲学反思那里，必然表象的杂多作为由自由产生出来的体系而出现——在这种意义上，一个客观世界的无意识生产并不被主张为自由的行动（因为就这一点而言，经验意识和哲学意识是对立的），而是就两者都是自我设定的同一性而言被主张的；自我设定，即主体和客体的同一性，是自由的活动。
在前面从纯粹意识或自我设定出发对客观世界之生产的阐述中，必然出现了一种绝对的对立；如果客观世界要被演绎为自由的一个行动，这种对立就表现为我通过自己对自己的自我限制，而生产性的想象力则是由两个因素建构起来的：一个是无规定的、趋向无限的活动，另一个是限制性的、趋向有限化的活动。
如果反思着的活动也同样被设定为无限的活动——它在这里既然是观念的因素，是绝对对立的东西，就必须这样被设定——那么它本身也可以被设定为自由的一个行动，而我就是自由地限制自己。
这样一来，自由和限制就不会互相立在对立之中，而是会无限地——并且有限地——设定自己：这与上面作为第一和第二个根本命题的对立而出现的东西是同一回事。
限制由此诚然是内在的东西，因为正是我在限制自己；客体之被设定只是为了解释这种限制，而智性的自我限制是唯一实在的东西。
这样一来，经验意识在主体和客体之间设定的那种绝对对立就被扬弃了，但它以另一种形式被带进了智性本身；智性于是发现自己被关进了不可理解的界限之中，自我限制是它绝对不可理解的法律；而恰恰是普通意识的对立对智性来说的不可理解性，才是驱使人去思辨的东西。
但这种不可理解性由于被设定进智性本身的限制而留在这个体系里，打破这个限制的圈子是哲学需要的唯一兴趣。——如果自由被设定为限制性活动的对立面，即自我设定与对立相对，那么自由就是有条件的，而这是不应有的；如果限制性活动也被设定为自由的一种活动——就像上面自我设定和对立都被设定进我之中那样——那么自由就是绝对同一性，但它与自己的现象相矛盾，而现象始终是非同一的、有限的和不自由的东西。
自由在体系中没有成功地生产出自己；产物并不符合生产者；从自我设定出发的体系把智性引向它的有条件的条件，引向无穷的有限东西，却没有在它们之中、从它们出发把智性重新建立起来。

en: Because in unconscious producing speculation cannot fully exhibit its principle I = I, but the object of the theoretical faculty necessarily contains in itself something not determined by the I, we are referred to the practical faculty.

The I cannot succeed through unconscious producing in positing itself as I = I or in intuiting itself as subject = object; the demand therefore still stands that the I produce itself as identity, as subject = object, that is, practically, that the I metamorphose itself into the object.

This highest demand remains a demand in the Fichtean system; it is not only not resolved into a genuine synthesis, but is fixed as a demand, so that the ideal is absolutely opposed to the real and the highest self-intuition of the I as a subject = object is made impossible.
zh: 因为在无意识的生产中，思辨不能完整地指出自己的原则 我 = 我，而理论能力的客体又必然在自身中包含着某种并非由我规定的东西，所以就被引向了实践能力。
我不可能通过无意识的生产成功地把自己设定为 我 = 我，或者把自己直观为主体 = 客体；所以要求依然存在：我必须把自己作为同一性、作为主体 = 客体生产出来，也就是实践地生产出来，我必须把自己变形为客体。
这个最高的要求费希特体系中始终只是一个要求；它不仅没有被消解为真正的综合，反而被固定为一个要求，从而使观念物与实在物绝对对立，并使我这个主体 = 客体的最高自我直观成为不可能。

en: I = I is practically postulated, and this is represented in such a way that the I in this manner becomes an object to itself as I, in that it enters into the relation of causality with the not-I, whereby the not-I would vanish and the object would be something absolutely determined by the I, thus = I.
Here the relation of causality becomes dominant, and thereby reason, or the subject = object, is fixed as one of the opposed, and the true synthesis is made impossible.
zh: 我 = 我被实践地公设，并且被这样表象出来：我以这种方式成为对我自己而言作为我的客体，因为它与非我进入因果性关系，由此非我消失，而客体成为绝对由我规定的东西，因而 = 我。
