在这里，因果性关系成了主导，理性或者说主体 = 客体由此被固定为对立面之一，真正的综合也就被弄成不可能。

en: This impossibility - that the I reconstructs itself out of the opposition of subjectivity and of the X that arises for it in unconscious production, and becomes one with its appearance - expresses itself in this way, that the highest synthesis that the system exhibits is an ought.
I equal to I transforms itself into: I ought to be equal to I; the result of the system does not return into its beginning.
zh: 这种不可能性——我无法从主观性与那个在无意识的生产中向它产生的 X 的对立中重建自身、并与其现象成为一体——是这样表达出来的：体系所展示的最高综合是一个应当。
我等于我转化为：我应当等于我；体系的结果并不回到它的开端。

en: The I ought to annihilate the objective world, the I ought to have absolute causality upon the not-I18); this is found to be contradictory, for thereby the not-I would be sublated, and the opposing, or the positing, of a not-I is absolute.
The relation of pure activity to an object can therefore only be posited as striving19).

The objective I, which is equal to the subjective, has, because it presents I = I, an opposing, hence a not-I, at the same time over against itself; the former, the ideal, and the latter, the real, ought to be equal.

This practical postulate of the absolute ought expresses nothing but a thought union of the opposition, which does not unite into an intuition, only the antithesis of the first and second fundamental propositions.
zh: 我应当消灭客观世界，我应当对非我有绝对的因果性18)；这一点被发现是矛盾的，因为这样一来非我就会遭到扬弃，而对立、或者说设定一个非我，是绝对的。
所以，纯粹活动对一个客体的关系只能被设定为努力19)。
客观的、与主观的我相等的我，因为它表述我 = 我，所以同时有一个对立、也就是一个非我对着它自己；前者，观念物，和后者，实在物，应当相等。
这个绝对应当的实践公设，表达的不过是对立的一种被思考到的统一——它并不在直观中统一起来——，表达的只是第一根本命题和第二根本命题的反题。

en: I = I has hereby been abandoned by speculation and has fallen to reflection; pure consciousness no longer appears as absolute identity, but in its highest dignity it is opposed to empirical consciousness. - From this it is clear what character freedom has in this system; namely, it is not the sublation of the opposed, but the opposition against them, and in this opposition it is fixed as negative freedom.
Reason constitutes itself through reflection as a unity to which a manifoldness stands absolutely opposed; the ought expresses this existing opposition, the non-being of absolute identity.
Pure positing, free activity, is posited, as an abstraction, in the absolute form of something subjective.

The transcendental intuition from which the system proceeds was, in the form of philosophical reflection, which raises itself to the pure thinking of itself through absolute abstraction, something subjective; in order to have the transcendental intuition in its true formlessness, abstraction had to be made from this character of something subjective; speculation had to remove this form from its subjective principle in order to raise it to the true identity of subject and object.

Thus, however, the transcendental intuition insofar as it belongs to philosophical reflection, and the transcendental intuition insofar as it is neither subjective nor objective, have remained one and the same.

The subject = object no longer comes out of difference and out of reflection; it remains a subjective subject = object, to which the appearance is absolutely something foreign, and which does not attain to intuiting itself in its appearance.
zh: 我 = 我由此被思辨抛弃，落入了反思之手；纯粹意识不再作为绝对同一性出现，而是在它最高的尊严中与经验意识相对立。——从这里可以看出，自由在这个体系中具有怎样的性质；也就是说，它不是对立面的扬弃，而是与对立面的对立，并在这种对立中被固定为否定的自由。
理性通过反思把自己构成为统一体，而绝对地有一个杂多与它相对立；应当表达的就是这种现存的对立，即绝对同一性的不存在。
纯粹的设定、自由的活动，作为一种抽象，被设定在一种主观东西的绝对形式中。
体系由之出发的先验直观，在哲学反思的形式中——这种反思通过绝对抽象把自己提升为对自身的纯粹思维——是一种主观的东西；要拥有在其真正无形式性中的先验直观，就必须从这种主观东西的性质中抽象掉；思辨必须从它主观的原则上除去这一形式，以便把它提升到主体与客体的真正同一性。
但这样一来，先验直观，就它属于哲学反思而言，与先验直观，就它既不是主观的也不是客观的而言，就仍然是同一个东西。
主体 = 客体再也走不出差别和反思；它始终是一个主观的主体 = 客体，现象对它来说绝对是一个异己的东西，而它也无法达到在它的现象中直观自身。

en: As little as the theoretical faculty of the I could attain to absolute self-intuition, so little can the practical one; this, like that, is conditioned by an impulse, which as a fact cannot be derived from the I, and the deduction of which has the meaning that it is shown to be the condition of the theoretical and practical faculty.
The antinomy remains as antinomy and is expressed in striving, which is the ought as activity.

This antinomy is not the form in which the absolute appears to reflection, as for reflection no other grasping of the absolute than through antinomy is possible; rather this opposition of the antinomy is the fixed, the absolute: it is supposed, as activity, namely as a striving, to be the highest synthesis, and the idea of infinity is to remain an idea in the Kantian sense, in which it is absolutely opposed to intuition.

This absolute opposition of the idea and of intuition, and the synthesis of the two, which is nothing but a self-destroying demand, namely a demand for union, which however is not to happen, expresses itself in the infinite progress.
The absolute opposition is hereby pushed into the form of a lower standpoint, which has long passed for a true sublation of the opposition and the highest resolution of the antinomy by reason.
Determinate being prolonged into eternity includes both, the infinity of the idea and of intuition, but both in such forms as make their synthesis impossible.

The infinity of the idea excludes all manifoldness; time, by contrast, immediately includes opposition, an outside-one-another, within itself, and determinate being in time is something opposed to itself, manifold, and infinity is outside it. - Space is likewise a being-posited-outside-itself; but in its character of opposition it can be called an infinitely richer synthesis than time.

The preference that time receives, that the progress is to happen in it, can only consist in this, that striving is posited absolutely as opposed to an external world of sense and as something inner, whereby the I is hypostasized as absolute subject, as the unity of the point, and more popularly as soul. - If time is to be totality, as infinite time, then time itself is sublated, and there was no need to flee to its name and to a progress of prolonged determinate being.
The true sublating of time is timeless present, i.e. eternity; and in this, striving and the persistence of absolute opposition fall away.

That prolonged determinate being only glosses over the opposition in the synthesis of time, whose poverty, through this glossing connection with an infinity absolutely opposed to it, is not completed but becomes more striking.
zh: 我的理论能力不能达到绝对的自直观，实践能力同样不能；后者和前者一样，都以一种阻抗为条件，这种阻抗作为事实无法从我推导出来，而对它的演绎的意义在于，它被指明为理论能力和实践能力的条件。
二律背反仍然是二律背反，并在努力中被表达出来，而努力就是作为活动的应当。
这个二律背反并不是绝对者在反思中显现的形式——因为对反思来说，除了通过二律背反，不可能有别的把握绝对者的方式；相反，二律背反的这种对立才是被固定下来的东西，才是绝对者：它作为活动、也就是作为一种努力，应当是最高的综合，而无限性的观念应当仍然是一个康德意义上的观念，在那种意义上它与直观绝对对立。
观念与直观的这种绝对对立，以及二者的综合——这种综合不过是一个自我毁灭的要求，即要求统一，但这种统一又不应当发生——，在无限的进展中表达出来。
绝对的对立由此被推到一个较低立场的形态中，这种形态长期以来被视为对立的真正扬弃，被视为理性对二律背反的最高解决。
被延长到永恒中的定在把两者都包含在自身内，即观念的无限性和直观的无限性，但两者都处在使它们的综合成为不可能的形式中。
观念的无限性排除一切杂多；与此相反，时间直接包含对立、包含一种相互外在，而时间中的定在是一个自身对立的东西、一个杂多的东西，无限性则在它之外。——空间同样是一种自身外的被设定；但就其对立的性质而言，它可以被称为比时间无限更丰富的综合。
时间所获得的那个优先地位，即进展应当在时间中发生，只能在于：努力被绝对地设定为与一个外在的感性世界相对立，并被设定为一种内在的东西，此时我被实体化为绝对的主体、设定为点的统一，更通俗地说被实体化为灵魂。——如果时间要成为总体性，作为无限的时间，那么时间本身就被扬弃了，也就不必逃到它的名号那里、逃到被延长的定在的进展那里去了。
对时间的真正扬弃是无时间的当下，也就是永恒；在永恒中，努力和绝对对立的持续都消失了。
那种被延长的定在只是在时间的综合中美化了对立，而时间的贫乏通过这种与一个对它绝对对立的无限性的美化性结合，并没有得到补全，反而变得更加显眼。

en: All further developments of what is contained in striving, and the syntheses of the oppositions resulting from the development, have in themselves the principle of non-identity.
The whole further execution of the system belongs to a consistent reflection; speculation has no part in it.
The absolute identity is present only in the form of something opposed, namely as idea; the incomplete causal relation lies at the ground of each of its unions with the opposed.

The I that posits itself in the opposition, or limits itself, and the I that goes into the infinite, enter - the former under the name of the subjective, the latter under the name of the objective - into this connection, that the self-determination of the subjective I is a determining according to the idea of the objective I, of absolute self-activity, of infinity, and the objective I, absolute self-activity, is determined by the subjective according to this idea.
Their determining is a reciprocal determining.

The subjective, ideal I receives from the objective, to put it this way, the matter of its idea, namely absolute self-activity, indeterminacy; the objective, into the infinite going, real I is limited by the subjective; but the subjective, because it determines according to the idea of infinity, again sublates the limitation, makes the objective in its infinity indeed finite, but at the same time in its finitude infinite.

In this reciprocal determining there remains the opposition of finitude and infinity, of real determinacy and ideal indeterminacy; ideality and reality are not united; or the I, as ideal and real activity at once, which differ only as different directions, has in individual incomplete syntheses, as will subsequently be shown, in drive, in feeling, united its different directions, but in them it does not arrive at a complete presentation of itself; it produces, in the infinite progress of prolonged determinate being, endlessly parts of itself, but not itself in the eternity of self-intuition as subject-object.
zh: 努力中所包含的东西的一切进一步展开，以及从这种展开中产生出来的各种对立的综合，自身都带有非同一性的原则。
体系此后全部的展开都属于一种一贯的反思；思辨在其中没有任何份。
绝对同一性只以对立面的形式、也就是作为观念而存在；它每一次与对立面的结合，都以那不完整的因果关系为基础。
在对立中设定自身的、或者说自我限制的我，与走向无限的我，前者以主观的名义、后者以客观的名义，进入这样一种结合：主观的我的自我规定，是按照客观的我、绝对的自发性、无限性的观念所作的规定，而客观的我、绝对的自发性，则通过主观的我按照这一观念而被规定。
它们的规定是一种交互规定。
主观的、观念的我从客观的我那里获得——如果这样表达的话——它的观念的材料，即绝对的自发性、无规定性；客观的、走向无限的、实在的我则被主观的我所限制；但主观的我，由于它是按照无限性的观念来规定的，就又把这种限制扬弃掉，使客观的我在其无限性中固然成为有限的，但同时在它的有限性中成为无限的。

在这种交互规定中，有限性与无限性、实在的规定性与观念的无规定性的对立依然留存；观念性和实在性没有统一起来；或者说，我作为同时是观念的与实在的活动——两者只作为不同的方向而相区别——，在个别的、不完整的综合中，正如后面将要表明的，在冲动中、在情感中，已经把它的不同方向统一了起来，但它在这些综合中并没有达到对自己的完整表述；它在被延长的定在的无限进展中无止境地生产出自己的各个部分，而不是在自我直观的永恒中作为主体—客体生产出自己本身。

en: The holding fast to the subjectivity of transcendental intuition - through which holding fast the I remains a subjective subject-object - appears most strikingly in the relation of the I to nature, partly in the deduction of the latter, partly in the sciences grounded on that deduction.
zh: 对先验直观的主观性的坚持——通过这种坚持，我始终是一个主观的主体—客体——，在我与自然的关系中表现得最为触目，一方面是在自然的演绎里，一方面是在那些建立在自然的演绎之上的科学里。

en: Because the I is a subjective subject-object, there remains to it a side from which an object is absolutely opposed to it, from which it is conditioned by that object; the dogmatic positing of an absolute object is transformed in this idealism, as we have seen, into a - to free activity absolutely opposed - self-limiting.
This being-posited of nature through the I is its deduction and the transcendental point of view; it will show itself how far this reaches and what its meaning is.
zh: 因为我是主观的主体—客体，所以就总还有一面留给我，从这一面有一个客体绝对地与我对立，从这一面我受这个客体制约；正如我们已经看到的，独断地设定一个绝对客体，在这种观念论里就转变成一种——与自由活动绝对对立的——自我限制。
自然通过我而被设定，这就是自然的演绎，也是先验的观点；这个观点能伸到多远、它的意义是什么，将会显示出来。

en: As a condition of intelligence an original determinacy is postulated, which above appeared as the necessity (because pure consciousness is not a complete consciousness) of proceeding to empirical consciousness.
The I is to limit itself absolutely, to oppose itself to itself; it is subject, and the limit is in the I and through the I.

This self-limiting becomes a limiting both of the subjective activity, of intelligence, and of the objective activity; the limited objective activity is the drive20); the limited subjective activity is the concept of purpose.
The synthesis of this doubled determinacy is feeling; in it cognition and drive are united.

At the same time, however, feeling is something merely subjective21), and in opposition to I = I, to the indeterminate, it indeed appears as something determinate in general, and specifically as something subjective in opposition to the I as something objective; it appears as something finite in general, both against infinite real activity and against ideal infinity, and in relation to the latter as something objective.

But in itself feeling has been characterized as the synthesis of the subjective and the objective, of cognition and of drive, and because it is a synthesis, its opposition to an indeterminate falls away, whether this indeterminate be an infinite objective or subjective activity.

It is finite at all only for reflection, which produces that opposition of infinity; in itself it is, like matter, subjective and objective at the same time, identity, insofar as this identity has not reconstructed itself into totality.
zh: 作为智性的条件，人们公设了一种原初的规定性，也就是前面显现为必然性的那种东西（因为纯粹意识不是完整的意识），即走向经验意识。
我应当绝对地限制自己、与自己对立；我是主体，而限制就在我之中、并通过我而来。
这种自我限制既成为主观活动即智性的限制，也成为客观活动的限制；受限制的客观活动就是冲动20），受限制的主观活动就是目的概念。
这种双重规定性的综合就是感觉；在感觉中，认识和冲动是结合在一起的。
但同时，感觉是一种纯然主观的东西21），在与我 = 我、与无规定者的对立中，它倒是显现为一种一般的规定之物，而且显现为一种主观的东西，与作为客观之物的我相对立；它显现为一种一般的有限之物，既相对于无限的实在活动，也相对于观念的无限性，而在与后者的关系中则显现为一种客观的东西。
但就其自身而言，感觉已经被规定为主观的东西与客观的东西、认识与冲动的综合，而因为它是综合，它与某个无规定者的对立就消失了，不论这个无规定者是无限的客观活动还是无限的主观活动。
它只是对反思而言才一般地是有限的，是反思生产出了那种无限性的对立；而自在地，它和物质一样同时是主观的东西和客观的东西，是同一性，只要这种同一性还没有把自己重建为总体性。

en: Feeling as well as drive appear as limited, and the manifestation of the limited and of limitation in us is drive and feeling; the original determinate system of drives and feelings is nature.

Since the consciousness of them forces itself upon us, and at the same time the substance in which this system of limitations is found is supposed to be the one that freely thinks and wills and that we posit as ourselves, it is our nature22); and the I and my nature make up the subjective subject-object, my nature is itself in the I.
zh: 感觉和冲动都显现为受限制的东西，而在我们之内，受限的东西和限制的表现就是冲动和感觉；冲动和感觉的那个原初的、确定了的系统就是自然。
因为对它们的意识硬挤到我们身上，而同时，这个限制的系统所处的那一实体，应当就是自由地思维和意愿、并且被我们设定为我们自己的实体，所以它就是我们的自然22）；而我和我的自然构成了主观的主体—客体，我的自然本身就在我之中。

en: But two kinds of mediation of the opposition of nature and freedom, of the originally limited and the originally unlimited, must be distinguished, and it is essential to prove that the mediation takes place in different ways; this will show us, in a new form, the difference of the transcendental standpoint and the standpoint of reflection, the latter of which displaces the former - the difference of the starting point and the result of this system.
zh: 但必须区分自然与自由、原初受限制者与原初不受限制者之对立的两种中介方式，而且本质上有必要证明：这种中介是以不同的方式发生的；这一点将以一种新的形态向我们表明先验的观点与反思的观点的区别——后者把前者排挤掉——，即这个体系的出发点与结果的区别。

en: On the one hand, I = I, freedom and drive are one and the very same - this is the transcendental point of view.

"Although one part of what belongs to me is supposed to be possible only through freedom, and another part of it is supposed to be independent of freedom and freedom independent of it, nevertheless the substance to which both belong is only one and the very same, and is posited as one and the very same.

I who feel, and I who think, I who am driven, and I who resolve myself with free will, am the same."23) "My drive as a natural being, my tendency as pure spirit, are [...] from the transcendental point of view one and the very same original drive that constitutes my essence, only it is regarded from two different sides"24); their difference is only in appearance.
zh: 一方面是我 = 我，自由和冲动是同一个东西，——这就是先验的观点。
“虽然属于我的东西中有一部分应当只有通过自由才可能，另一部分则应当不依赖于自由，而自由也不依赖于它，但两者所归属的那个实体仍然只是一个、并且是同一个，而且被设定为一个、同一个。
感觉着的我，和思维着的我，被驱动着的我，和以自由意志下决心的我，是同一个。”23）“我作为自然存在者的冲动，我作为纯粹精神的倾向，[…]从先验的观点看是同一个、并且是同一个构成我本质的原初冲动，只是它从两个不同的方面被看待”24）；它们的区别只在现象中。

en: On the other hand, the two are different, the one the condition of the other, the one ruling over the other.
Nature as drive must indeed be thought as determining itself through itself, but it is characterized by the opposition of freedom.

Nature determines itself, therefore means: it is determined, through its essence, formaliter, to determine itself; it can never be indeterminate, as a free being very well can be; it is likewise just so determined materialiter and does not, like the free being, have the choice between a certain determination and its opposite.25) The synthesis of nature and freedom now gives the following reconstruction of identity out of diremption into totality.

I, as intelligence, the indeterminate, - and I, who am driven, nature, the determinate, become the same through the drive coming to consciousness; insofar as it now stands in my power, it does not act at all in this region, but I act or do not act in accordance with it.26) - The reflecting is higher than the reflected; the drive of the reflecting, of the subject of consciousness, is called the higher drive27); the lower one, nature, must be brought into subjection to the higher, to reflection.
This relation of subjection of one appearance of the I to the other is supposed to be the highest synthesis.
zh: 另一方面，两者是不同的，一个是另一个的条件，一个统治着另一个。
自然作为冲动，虽然必须被设想为通过自身而自己规定自己，但它的特征却在于与自由的对立。
自然自己规定自己，这因此意味着：它通过自己的本质、formaliter（就形式而言），被规定为要规定自己；它永远不可能是无规定的，而一个自由的存在者却完全可以；它同样 materialiter（就质料而言）也恰恰是被规定的，不像自由的存在者那样，能在某个规定和与它相反的规定之间作选择。25）自然与自由的综合于是给出了下面这种从分裂出发把同一性重建为总体性的做法。
我作为智性、作为无规定者，——和我作为被驱动者、作为自然、作为有规定者，由于冲动达到意识而成为同一个；就此而言，冲动现在处于我的支配之下，它在这个领域里根本不起作用，而是我依照它行动或不行动。26）——反思着的东西高于被反思的东西；反思着的东西、即意识的主体的冲动，叫作更高的冲动27）；较低的那个冲动、即自然，必须被置于更高的东西、即反思的隶属之下。
我的这一种显现对另一种显现的这种隶属关系，应当就是最高的综合。

en: But this latter identity and the identity of the transcendental point of view are wholly opposed to each other.

In the transcendental [point of view] I = I, the I is posited into the relation of substantiality or at least still into the relation of reciprocity; in this reconstruction of identity, on the other hand, the one is the ruling, the other the ruled, the subjective is not equal to the objective, but they stand in the relation of causality, - one comes into subjection; of the two spheres of freedom and necessity, the latter is subordinated to the former.
Thus the end of the system becomes unfaithful to its beginning, the result to its principle.
The principle was I = I; the result is I not = I.
The former identity is an ideal-real one, form and matter are one; the latter is a merely ideal one, form and matter are separate; it is a merely formal synthesis.

This synthesis of ruling arises in the following way. Opposed to the pure drive, which goes towards absolute self-determination, to activity for the sake of activity, is an objective drive, a system of limitations.

In that freedom and nature unite, the former gives up its purity, the latter its impurity; the synthetic activity, in order to be pure and infinite after all, must be thought as an objective activity whose final end is absolute freedom, absolute independence from all nature, - a final end never to be attained28), an infinite series through whose continuation the I would become absolutely = I, that is, the I sublates itself as object, and thereby also as subject.

But it is not supposed to sublate itself; thus there is for the I only a time filled with limitations, quantities, indeterminably prolonged, and the well-known progress is to help out; where the highest synthesis is expected, there always remains the same antithesis of the limited present and an infinity lying outside it.

I = I is the absolute, the totality, outside the I nothing; but the I does not bring it this far in the system, and, if time is to be mixed in, never; it is absolutely affected by a not-I and can always only posit itself as a quantum of I.
zh: 但后一种同一性和先验观点的同一性是完全相互对立的。
在先验的观点里，我 = 我，我被设定进实体性关系，或者至少还被设定进交互关系；而在同一性的这种重建里，一方是统治的一方，另一方是被统治的一方，主观的东西不等于客观的东西，而是两者处于因果关系中，——一方落入隶属地位；在自由与必然性这两个领域里，后者从属于前者。
这样，体系的终点就对它的开端不忠，结果就对它的原则不忠。
原则曾经是我 = 我；结果却是我 ≠ 我。
前一种同一性是观念性—实在性的同一性，形式和物质是一；后一种则仅仅是观念性的同一性，形式和物质是分离的；它是一种纯然形式的综合。
这种统治的综合是这样产生的。与纯粹冲动——它趋向于绝对地自我规定、趋向于为活动而活动——相对立的，是一种客观的冲动，一个限制的系统。
当自由与自然结合起来时，前者放弃了自己的纯粹性，后者放弃了自己的不纯粹性；综合的活动为了毕竟还是纯粹而无限的，就必须被设想为一种客观的活动，这种活动的最终目的是绝对的自由、对一切自然的绝对独立，——一个永远达不到的最终目的28），一个无限的系列，通过这个系列的延续，我会绝对地成为我 = 我，也就是说，我作为客体扬弃自己，因此也作为主体扬弃自己。
但它不应当扬弃自己；于是对我来说就只有一种被限制、被量填满的、不可规定地延长了的时间，而那个众所周知的进展应当来救急；在人们期待最高综合的地方，留存的始终是同一个反题：受限制的当前与一种在它之外的无限性。
我 = 我是绝对者，是总体性，除我之外什么都没有；但我在体系里并没有走到这一步，而如果时间要被掺进来，就永远走不到；我绝对地受到一个非我的刺激，永远只能把自己设定为我的一个量。

en: Nature is thereby, in theoretical as well as in practical respect, something essentially determined and dead.

In the former respect it is the intuited self-limitation, i.e. the objective side of self-limiting; in that it is deduced as the condition of self-consciousness and, in order to explain self-consciousness, is posited, it is merely something posited by reflection for the sake of the explanation, something ideally effected.

Even if, by the very fact that self-consciousness is proved to be conditioned by it, it receives a dignity of independence equal to that of self-consciousness, yet, because it is posited only by reflection, its independence is thereby also annihilated, and its fundamental character is that of being-opposed.
zh: 因此，自然无论从理论方面还是从实践方面来看，都是本质上被规定的、死的东西。
在理论方面，它是被直观到的自我限制，也就是自我限制的客观方面；既然它是作为自我意识的条件被演绎出来，并且为了解释自我意识而被设定起来，那它就只是为着解释而通过反思被设定的东西，是观念地产生出来的东西。
如果说，正由于自我意识被证明为受它制约，它就此获得了与自我意识同等的独立性的尊严，那么，由于它只是通过反思被设定的，它的独立性也就因此被消灭了，而它的根本特性就是对立的、被对立的状态。

en: Likewise, in practical respect, in the synthesis of unconscious self-determining and of self-determining through a concept, of the natural drive and of the drive of freedom for the sake of freedom29), nature becomes, through the causality of freedom, something really effected.
The result is: the concept is to have causality upon nature, and nature is to be posited as something absolutely determined.
zh: 同样，在实践方面，在无意识的自我规定与通过概念的自我规定的综合中，在自然冲动与为自由之故的自由冲动29）的综合中，自然通过自由的因果性变成了实在地产生出来的东西。
结果是：概念应当对自然具有因果性，而自然应当被设定为绝对被规定的东西。

en: If reflection posits its analysis of the absolute wholly in an antinomy, acknowledging the one member as I, indeterminacy or self-determining, the other as object, being-determined, and both as original, then it asserts the relative unconditionality and thereby also the relative conditionedness of both.
Reflection cannot go beyond this interaction of mutual conditioning.

It proves itself to be reason by the fact that it sets up the antinomy of the conditioned unconditioned, and in that through this antinomy it points to an absolute synthesis of freedom and of the natural drive, it has not asserted the opposition and the persistence of both, or of one of them, and itself, as the absolute and eternal, but has annihilated them and plunged into the abyss of its consummation.

But if it asserts itself and one of its opposites as the absolute and holds fast to the relation of causality, then the transcendental point of view and reason have succumbed to the standpoint of mere reflection and to the understanding, which has succeeded in fixing the rational, in the form of an idea, as something absolutely opposed.

For reason there remains nothing but the powerlessness of the demand that sublates itself and the semblance of a - but an understanding, formal - mediation of nature and freedom in the mere idea of the sublation of the oppositions, in the idea of the independence of the I and of the absolute being-determined of nature, which is posited as something to be negated, as absolutely dependent.
But the opposition has not disappeared, but - because, if one member of it persists, the other also persists - has been made infinite.
zh: 如果反思把它对绝对者的分析完全放进一个二律背反里，把一项认作我、无规定性或自我规定，把另一项认作客体、被规定状态，并且把两者都认作原初的，那么它就是在主张两者的相对无条件性，并因此也主张两者的相对有条件性。
反思无法超出这种相互制约的交互作用。
反思表明自己是理性，靠的是它提出有条件的无条件者的二律背反；而由于它借此指向自由与自然冲动的绝对综合，它就没有把两者的对立与持存、或其中之一的持存、以及它自己坚持为绝对者和永恒者，而是消灭了它们，抛进它自身完成的深渊。
但如果它把自己和自己的对立面之一坚持为绝对者，并固守因果性关系，那么先验的观点和理性就败给了单纯反思的立场和知性，而后者成功地以观念的形式把理性的东西固定为绝对对立的东西。
对理性来说，剩下的只有自我扬弃的要求的无能，以及自然与自由的一种——但却是知性的、形式的——中介的假象，这种中介只在扬弃各种对立的单纯观念中，在我独立、自然绝对被规定这一观念中，而自然则被设定为有待否定的东西、绝对依赖的东西。
但对并没有消失，而是——因为只要它的一个项存在，另一个项也存在——被变成了无限的。

en: On this highest standpoint nature has the character of absolute objectivity or of death; only on a lower standpoint does it appear with the semblance of a life, as subject = object.

Just as on the highest standpoint the I does not lose the form of its appearance as subject, so on the other hand the character of nature, that of being subject = object, becomes a mere semblance, and absolute objectivity its essence.
zh: 在这个最高立场上，自然具有绝对客观性或死亡的特征；只有在较低的立场上，它才带着生命的假象，作为主体 = 客体出现。
正如在最高立场上我并不失去它作为主体而显现的形式，反过来，自然作为主体 = 客体这一特征却成了单纯的假象，而绝对客观性成了它的本质。

en: For nature is the unconscious producing of the I, and producing of the I is a self-determining, so nature is itself I, subject = object; and as soon as my nature is posited, there is still nature outside of mine, which is not the whole of nature; the nature outside of me is posited in order to explain my nature.

Because my nature is determined as a drive, a self-determining through itself, the nature outside of me must likewise be so determined, and this determination outside of me is the ground of explanation of my nature.30)
zh: 因为自然是我的无意识的生产，而我的生产是一种自我规定，所以自然本身也就是我，是主体 = 客体；而一旦我的自然被设定起来，我的自然之外就还有自然，后者并不是全部的自然；我之外的自然被设定起来，是为了解释我的自然。
因为我的自然被规定为一种冲动，一种通过自身的自我规定，所以我之外的自然也必须这样被规定，而这个在我之外的规定就是我自然的解释根据。30）

en: Of this self-determining through itself, the products of reflection, cause and effect, whole and part, etc., must now be predicated in their antinomy, and nature must thus be posited as cause and effect of itself, as whole and part at the same time, etc., whereby it receives the semblance of being something living and organic.31)
zh: 对于这个通过自身而自我规定的东西，现在必须把反思的产物——原因与结果、整体与部分等等——在其二律背反中加以述谓，因而把自然设定为它自身的原因与结果、同时既是整体又是部分等等，自然由此获得假象，仿佛是有生命的东西和有机的东西。31）

en: But this standpoint, on which the objective is characterized by the reflecting power of judgement as something living, becomes a lower standpoint.
For the I finds itself only as nature insofar as it solely intuits its original limitedness and posits the absolute limit of the original drive, thus itself, objectively.

On the transcendental standpoint, however, subject = object is acknowledged only in pure consciousness, in unlimited self-positing; but this self-positing has an absolute opposing against itself, which is thereby determined as the absolute limit of the original drive.
Insofar as the I, as drive, does not determine itself according to the idea of infinity, thus posits itself finitely, this finite is nature; as I, it is at the same time infinite and subject-object.
The transcendental point of view, because it posits only the infinite as I, thereby makes a separation of the finite and the infinite.
It draws subject-objectivity out of what appears as nature, and there remains to the latter nothing but the dead shell of objectivity.
To it, the previously finite-infinite, infinity is taken away, and it remains pure finitude, opposed to the I = I; what was I in it is drawn over to the subject.

Now if the transcendental point of view proceeds from the identity, I = I, in which there is neither anything subjective nor anything objective, to the difference of the two, which has remained as an opposing against self-positing, against I = I, and determines the opposed ever further, then it also arrives at a standpoint on which nature is posited for itself, as subject = object; but it should not be forgotten that this view of nature is only a product of reflection on the lower standpoint.

In the transcendental deduction the limit of the original drive (objectively posited - nature) remains a pure objectivity absolutely opposed to the original drive, to the true essence, which is I = I, subject = object.
This opposition is the condition through which the I becomes practical, i.e. must sublate the opposition; this sublation is thought in such a way that the one is posited as dependent on the other.

In practical respect nature is posited as something absolutely determined by the concept; insofar as it is not determined by the I, the I has no causality or is not practical; and the standpoint which posited nature as living falls away again, for its essence, its in-itself, was to be nothing but a limit, a negation.

On this practical standpoint reason remains nothing but the dead and deadening rule of formal unity, given into the hand of reflection, which posits subject and object into the relation of the dependence of the one on the other, or of causality, and in this way entirely removes the principle of speculation, identity.
zh: 不过，这个由反思的判断力把客观的东西刻画为有生命之物的立场，却变成了一个较低的立场。
因为，我只有在这种情况下才把自己当作自然，即它只直观到自己原初的有限性，并把原初冲动的绝对界限、因而把自己客观地设定起来。
但在先验立场上，主体 = 客体只在纯粹意识中、在无限制的自我设定中被承认；而这种自我设定却有一个针对自身的绝对对立，它由此被规定为原初冲动的绝对界限。
就我作为冲动并不按照无限性的观念来规定自己、因而把自己设定为有限的而言，这个有限的东西就是自然；它作为我，同时是无限的并且是主体—客体。
先验的观点由于只把无限的东西设定为我，由此造成了有限与无限的分割。
它把主体—客体性从显现为自然的东西中抽出来，留给后者的就只剩下客观性的死壳。
它，即先前那个有限—无限的东西，被夺走了无限性，它只留下纯粹的有限性，与我 = 我相对立；它之中曾经属于我的东西，被归到了主体那边。
如果先验观点从同一性、从我 = 我（其中既没有主观的东西也没有客观的东西）进到两者的差别（这差别作为针对自我设定、针对我 = 我的对立而留存下来），并不断进一步规定对立的两项，那么它也会达到一个立场，在这个立场上自然自为地被设定为主体 = 客体；但不应忘记，这种对自然的看法只是较低立场上反思的产物。
在先验演绎中，原初冲动的界限（客观地被设定起来——自然）始终是一种与原初冲动、与那个作为我 = 我、主体 = 客体的真正本质绝对对立的纯粹客观性。
这种对立是我成为实践的条件，也就是说，我必须扬弃这种对立；而这种扬弃被设想为：一方被设定为依赖于另一方。
在实践方面，自然被设定为绝对通过概念被规定的东西；就自然不是由我规定的而言，我就没有因果性，或者就不是实践的；而那个把自然设定为有生命的立场又重新消失了，因为自然的本质、它的自在，本该只是一个界限、一个否定。
在这个实践立场上，理性剩下的只是形式同一性的死板而致死的规则，被交到反思手里；而反思把主体与客体置入一方依赖另一方的关系或因果关系之中，并以此把思辨的原则、即同一性完全清除掉。

en: In the presentation and deduction of nature, as it is given in the system of natural law, the absolute opposition of nature and reason and the dominion of reflection show themselves in all their hardness.
zh: 在自然法体系里所给出的对自然的陈述和演绎中，自然与理性的绝对对立，以及反思的统治，以其全部的严酷显示出来。

en: For the rational being must form for itself a sphere for its freedom; it ascribes this sphere to itself; but it is this sphere itself only in opposition, only insofar as it posits itself exclusively into it in such a way that no other person may choose therein; in ascribing it to itself, it at the same time essentially posits it as opposed to itself.

The subject - as the absolute, active in itself and self-determining to the thinking of an object - posits the sphere of its freedom, which belongs to it, outside itself, and itself as separated from it32), and its relation to the same is only a having.

The basic character of nature is to be a world of the organic, an absolutely opposed thing; the essence of nature is an atomistic dead thing, a more fluid or more tenacious and more durable matter33), which in manifold ways is reciprocally cause and effect.

The concept of interaction diminishes but little the complete opposition of the merely causal and the merely effected; matter thereby becomes in manifold ways mutually modifiable; but even the force for this meagre connection lies outside it.

The independence of the parts, by virtue of which they are supposed to be organic wholes in themselves, as well as the dependence of the parts on the whole, is the teleological dependence on the concept, for the articulation34) is posited for the sake of an other, of the rational being, which is essentially separated from it.
Air, light, etc. become atomistic, formable matter, and indeed matter here in general in the ordinary sense, as absolutely opposed to the self-positing.
zh: 因为理性存在者必须为自己形成一个自由的地盘；这个地盘它归之于自己；但它本身只是在对立中、只是就它排他地把自己设定于其中，使没有别人能在其中作选择而言，才是这个地盘；当它把这个地盘归之于自己时，它同时就本质地把它设定为与自己对立。
主体——作为绝对者，作为在自身中活动、并自我规定着去思维一个客体的东西——把属于它的自由地盘设定到自己之外，并把自己设定为与这个地盘分离32)，它同这个地盘的关系只是一种占有。
自然的根本性格在于：它是有机物的一个世界，是一个绝对被对立起来的东西；自然的本质是一种原子式的死东西，是一种或更流动、或更黏滞而更坚固的质料33)，这种质料以多种方式互为原因和结果。
交互作用的概念很少削弱单纯原因性的东西与单纯被产生的东西之间的完全对立；质料由此以多种方式相互可被改变；但就连这种贫乏联结的力量，也处在质料之外。
部分的独立性——凭这种独立性，它们应当自在地就是有机的整体——以及部分对整体的依赖，就是对概念的目的论依赖，因为这种分节34)是为了一个他者、为了那个本质上与它分离的理性存在者而设定的。
空气、光等等成了原子式的、可赋形的质料，而且这里的质料完全是在通常意义上说的，即作为绝对与自我设定者相对立的东西。

en: In this way Fichte comes closer than Kant to coming to terms with the opposition of nature and freedom and to showing nature as something absolutely effected and dead; in the latter, nature is likewise posited as something absolutely determinate.

But because nature cannot be thought as determined through that which in Kant is called understanding, but rather its particular manifold appearances are left undetermined by our human discursive understanding, they must be thought as determined through another understanding, yet in such a way that this counts only as a maxim of our reflecting power of judgement and nothing is decided about the actuality of another understanding.

Fichte does not need this detour of first letting nature become something determinate through the idea of another understanding apart from the human one; nature is so immediately through and for the intelligence.

This intelligence limits itself absolutely, and this self-limiting is not to be derived from I = I, but only to be deduced from it, i.e. its necessity is to be shown from the defectiveness of pure consciousness, and the intuition of this its absolute limitedness, of the negation, is objective nature.
zh: 费希特以这种方式比康德更接近于了结自然与自由的对立，并把自然表明为一种绝对被产生的、死的东西；在康德那里，自然同样被设定为一种绝对被规定的东西。
但因为自然并不能通过康德那里叫作知性的东西被规定地思维，相反，它那些特殊的杂多现象被我们人类的推演性知性留在无规定状态，所以它们必须通过另一个知性被规定地思维，不过情形是这样：这一点只作为我们反思判断力的一条准则有效，而关于另一个知性的现实性则什么也没有断定。
费希特并不需要这条绕道，即先通过一个不同于人类知性的、另外的知性的观念，让自然成为某种被规定的东西；自然直接地通过智性、并为着智性就是这样的东西。
这个智性绝对地限制自己，而这种自我限制不能从我 = 我推导出来，只能从其中演绎出来，也就是说，要从纯粹意识的有缺陷性中表明它的必然性；而对这种绝对受限状态、对这种否定的直观，就是客观的自然。

en: More striking, on account of the consequences that follow from it, does this relation of the dependence of nature on the concept, the opposition of reason, become in the two systems of the community of human beings.
zh: 由于由此产生的后果，自然对概念的依赖这一关系、理性的这种对立，在关于人的共同体的两个体系里就变得更加触目。

en: This community is represented as a community of rational beings, which must take the detour through the dominion of the concept.

Every rational being is doubled for the other: a) a free, rational being; b) a modifiable matter, something capable of being treated as a mere thing.35) This separation is absolute, and once it lies at the basis in its unnaturalness, no pure relation to one another is any longer possible, in which the original identity would present and cognize itself, but every relation is a ruling and being ruled according to the laws of a consistent understanding; the whole edifice of the community of living beings is built by reflection.
zh: 这种共同体被表象为一种理性存在者的共同体，它必须走那条通过概念统治的绕道。
每个理性存在者对另一个来说都是双重的：a) 一个自由的、理性的存在者；b) 一种可改变的质料，一种能被当作单纯物件来对待的东西。35) 这种分离是绝对的，而它一旦以其非自然性作为基础，彼此之间就不再可能有纯粹的关系，让原初的同一性在这种关系里表现自身并认识自身，相反，每一种关系都成了按照前后一贯的知性的法律而来的统治与被统治；活的存在者的共同体的整座建筑，都是反思建造起来的。

en: The community of rational beings appears as conditioned by the necessary limitation of freedom, which itself gives itself the law to limit itself36); and the concept of limiting constitutes a realm of freedom, in which every truly free, in itself infinite and unlimited, i.e. beautiful, interrelation of life is destroyed by the fact that the living is torn apart into concept and matter and nature comes under a subjection. - Freedom is the character of rationality, it is that which in itself sublates all limitation and the highest thing in Fichte's system; but in community with others it must be surrendered so that the freedom of all rational beings standing in community may be possible, and the community is in turn a condition of freedom; freedom must sublate itself in order to be freedom.

From this it is again evident that freedom here is something merely negative, namely absolute indeterminacy, or, as was shown above about self-positing, a purely ideal factor - freedom considered from the standpoint of reflection.

This freedom is found not as reason, but as rational being, i.e. synthesized with its opposite, a finite thing; and already this synthesis of personality includes within itself the limitation of one of the ideal factors, as here freedom is.

Reason and freedom as rational being is no longer reason and freedom, but a single thing; and the community of the person with others must therefore essentially be regarded not as a limitation of the true freedom of the individual, but as an extension of the same.

The highest community is the highest freedom, both as to power and as to exercise, - but in this highest community precisely freedom, as ideal factor, and reason, as opposed to nature, entirely drop away.
zh: 理性存在者的共同体显现为受到自由的必然限制的制约，而这自由自己给自己立下法律，要限制自己36)；限制这一概念构成一个自由的王国，在其中，生命的一切真正自由的、自为地无限而无限制的、也就是美的相互关系都被消灭了，因为活的东西被撕裂成概念和质料，自然落入了受支配的状态。——自由是理性性的特征，它是在自身中扬弃一切限制的东西，是费希特体系的最高者；但在与他人的共同体中，它必须被放弃，以便所有处于共同体中的理性存在者的自由成为可能，而共同体又是自由的一个条件；自由必须扬弃自己，才是自由。
由此又可以看出，自由在这里是一个单纯否定的东西，即绝对的无规定性，或者，正如上面就自我设定所表明的那样，是一个纯粹观念的因素——这是从反思的立场来看的自由。
这种自由不是作为理性、而是作为理性存在者被遇到的，也就是说，与其对立面、与一个有限的东西综合在一起；而人格性的这种综合本身就已经包含着对诸观念因素之一的限制，在这里就是自由。
作为理性存在者的理性和自由，不再是理性和自由，而是一个单一的东西；因此，人格与他人的共同体，本质上必须不被看作对个体真正自由的限制，而被看作这种自由的扩展。
最高的共同体就是最高的自由，无论就力量还是就施行而言都是如此，——但恰恰在这种最高的共同体中，自由作为观念的因素、理性作为与自然相对立的东西，完全消失了。

en: If the community of rational beings were essentially a limiting of true freedom, then it would be in and for itself the highest tyranny; but because for the present it is only freedom as indeterminate and ideal factor that is limited, no tyranny arises immediately, for itself, from that representation in the community.

But it arises most completely through the manner in which freedom is to be limited so that the freedom of the other rational beings may be possible; namely, through the community freedom is not to lose the form of being something ideal and opposed, but is to become fixed and ruling as such.
Through a genuinely free community of living relations, the individual has renounced its indeterminacy, that is, freedom.

In the living relation there is freedom only insofar as it includes within itself the possibility of sublating itself and entering into other relations; i.e. freedom has dropped away as ideal factor, as indeterminacy; indeterminacy is, in a living relation, insofar as it is free, only the possible, not an actual made into the ruling thing, not a commanding concept.

But the sublated indeterminacy is not understood in the free limitation of one's freedom in the system of natural law; rather, since the limitation is raised to law by the common will and fixed as concept, true freedom, the possibility of sublating a determinate relation, is destroyed.

The living relation is no longer able to be indeterminate, is therefore no longer rational, but absolutely determinate and fixed by the understanding; life has entered into subjection, and reflection has carried off the dominion over it and the victory over reason.

This state of need is asserted as natural law, and indeed not in such a way that the highest goal would be to sublate it and, in place of this understanding-governed and unreasonable community, to construct through reason an organization of life free from all servitude under the concept, but rather the state of need and its infinite extension over all stirrings of life counts as absolute necessity.

This community under the dominion of the understanding is not represented in such a way that it would have to make it its supreme law to sublate this need of life, into which life is posited by the understanding, and this endlessness of determining and ruling, in the true infinity of a beautiful community, to make laws dispensable through customs, the excesses of unsatisfied life through hallowed enjoyment, and the crimes of oppressed force through possible activity for great objects; on the contrary, the dominion of the concept and the servitude of nature is made absolute and extended into the infinite.
zh: 如果理性存在者的共同体本质上是对真正自由的限制，那么它自在地、自为地就会是最高的专制；但因为目前被限制的只是作为无规定的东西和观念的因素的自由，所以仅凭那种表象，在共同体中还不直接产生专制。
但它最完整地产生出来，靠的是自由应当被限制的那种方式，为的是让其他理性存在者的自由成为可能；也就是说，自由不应当通过共同体失去那种形式，即成为一种观念的、对立的东西，而应当作为这样的东西被固定下来并取得统治。
通过一种真正自由的、活的关系的共同体，个体已经放弃了自己的无规定性，也就是放弃了自由。
在活的关系中，自由只是就它自身包含着扬弃自己并进入其他关系的可能性而言才存在；也就是说，自由作为观念的因素、作为无规定性已经消失；在一种活的关系中，就这种关系是自由的而言，无规定性只是可能的东西，而不是被弄成统治者的现实的东西，不是发号施令的概念。
但在自然法体系中，在对自己自由的自由限制之下，被扬弃的无规定性并没有被理解到；相反，由于限制通过共同意志被提升为法律并被固定为概念，真正的自由、即扬弃一种特定关系的可能性，就被消灭了。
活的关系不再能够是无规定的，因此不再是理性的，而是绝对被规定的、由知性固定下来的；生命已经陷入受支配的状态，反思则赢得了对生命的统治和对理性的胜利。
这种困境状态被当作自然法来主张，而且并不是这样主张的：最高的目标在于扬弃它，并取代这种知性的、非理性的共同体，通过理性建构起一种摆脱概念之下一切奴役的、生命的组织；相反，困境状态以及它向生命一切活动的无限扩展，被视为绝对必然性。
这种处于知性统治之下的共同体，并不是这样被表象的：它必须把下面这一点当作自己最高的法律，即在一种美的共同体的真正无限性中扬弃生命这种由知性置入的困境，扬弃这种规定和统治的无止境，让法律通过习俗、让未得满足的生命的放纵通过神圣的享受、让受压迫的力量的罪行通过为伟大对象而进行的可能活动成为多余；相反，概念的统治和自然的奴役被弄成绝对的，并被扩展到无限。

en: The endlessness of determining, into which the understanding must fall, shows most immediately the defectiveness of its principle, of ruling through the concept. - Even this emergency state knows the purpose of preventing the violations of its citizens more than avenging them once they have already happened.

It must therefore not only forbid actual violation under penalties, but also forestall the possibility of a violation, must for that final end prohibit actions which in and for themselves harm no human being and seem wholly indifferent, but which make the violation of others easier and make the protection of those others or the discovery of the guilty more difficult.37) If now on the one hand the human being submits himself to a state from no other drive than to use and enjoy his capacity as freely as possible, then on the other hand there is absolutely no action of which the consistent understanding of this state could not calculate a possible harm for others, and it is with this endless possibility that the preventive understanding and its power, the duty of the police, have to do, and there is in this ideal of a state no doing and stirring that would not necessarily have to be subjected to a law, placed under immediate supervision and attended to by the police and the other rulers, so that (2. Teil, S. 155 [SW, Bd. III, S. 302]) in a state with the constitution set up according to this principle the police knows pretty well where every citizen is at every hour of the day and what he is up to.38)
zh: 规定活动的无止境，是知性必然陷入其中的，它最直接地显示出知性这条原则的缺陷，也就是通过概念来统治。——即便是这种应急国家，也懂得这个目的：与其在侵害已经发生之后去报复，不如更多地防止对它的公民的侵害。

所以它不仅必须用刑罚禁止现实的侵害，还必须预防侵害的可能性，为了这个终极目的而禁止一些行为：这些行为本身不损害任何人、显得完全无所谓，却使对别人的侵害更容易发生，使对这些人的保护或对罪人的查获更加困难。37）如果说一方面，人服从国家，除了为了尽可能自由地使用和享受自己的能力之外，也仍旧不是出于别的什么冲动，那么另一方面，就根本没有任何一种行为，是这个国家里前后一贯的知性不能算出它对别人可能造成的损害的；而预防性的知性及其暴力，也就是警察的职责，要对付的正是这种无止境的可能性；在这个国家的理想里，没有任何一举一动不必被置于某种法律之下、不必受到直接监视、不必由警察和其他治理者加以注意，以至于（2. Teil, S. 155 [SW, Bd. III, S. 302]）在一个按这条原则建立起宪制的国家里，警察差不多知道每个公民在一天里的每个钟头在哪里、在干什么。38）

en: In this infinity, into which it must go on, determining and being-determined have sublated themselves.

The limitation of freedom is itself supposed to be infinite; in this antinomy of unlimited boundedness, the restricting of freedom and the state have vanished; the theory of determining has annihilated determining, its principle, by extending it into the infinite.
zh: 在这种它必然一路走下去的无限性里，规定和被规定已经把自己扬弃了。
对自由的限制本身应当是无限的；在这种无界限的受限制状态的二律背反里，对自由的限定和国家都已经消失了；规定的理论通过把规定、把它的原则扩展到无限，也就把规定毁掉了。

en: The ordinary states39) are inconsistent in this, that they extend their supreme police right only to a few possibilities of violation and for the rest entrust the citizens to themselves, in the hope that each need not first be restricted by a concept and by virtue of a law from modifying the other's modifiable matter - as in fact each can, since as a rational being he must, according to his freedom as determining, posit the not-I and ascribe to himself the capacity to modify matter in general.

The imperfect states are imperfect because they must fix some opposition; they are inconsistent because they do not carry their opposition through all relations; but to make the opposition that absolutely sunders the human being into a rational being and a modifiable matter infinite and the determining endless - this consistency sublates itself, and that inconsistency is the most perfect thing about imperfect states.
zh: 通常的国家39）在这一点上是不一贯的：它们只把最高的警察权扩展到少数几种侵害的可能性上，其余的则让公民自己去管，希望每个人不必先通过一个概念、凭一条法律才被限制住不去改动别人的可改变的物质——而每个人其实都能这么做，因为他作为理性存在者，必须按照自己作为规定的自由去设定非我，并且必须把一般地改变物质的能力归给自己。
不完善的国家之所以不完善，是因为它们必须固定某种对立；它们之所以不一贯，是因为它们不把这种对立贯穿到一切关系里去；但是，把那种把人绝对分裂为理性存在者和可改变物质的对立弄成无限的、让规定变成无止境的——这种一贯性自己扬弃自己，而那种不一贯反倒是不完善的国家身上最完善的东西。

en: Natural law becomes, through the absolute opposition of the pure drive and the natural drive, a presentation of the complete dominion of the understanding and the servitude of the living - a building in which reason has no part and which it therefore rejects, because in the most perfect organization it can give itself, in self-formation into a people, it must find itself most expressly.

But that state of the understanding is not an organization but a machine; the people is not the organic body of a common and rich life but an atomistic, life-poor multiplicity, whose elements are absolutely opposed substances, partly a multitude of points, the rational beings, partly matters modifiable in many ways through reason - i.e. in this form: through understanding - elements whose unity is a concept, whose connection is an endless domination.

This absolute substantiality of the points grounds a system of atomism of practical philosophy, in which, as in the atomism of nature, an understanding foreign to the atoms becomes law, which in the practical sphere calls itself right, a concept of totality that is supposed to oppose itself to every action - for every action is a determinate one - to determine it, and thus to kill the living in it, the true identity.

Fiat iustitia, pereat mundus is the law, not even in the sense in which Kant interpreted it40): let right be done, even if all the knaves in the world perish, but rather: right must be done, even though for that reason trust, joy and love, all the potencies of a genuinely ethical identity, would be rooted out, as the saying goes, root and branch.
zh: 自然法由于纯粹冲动与自然冲动的绝对对立，成了一种表述：知性的完全统治和活东西的受奴役——一座理性在其中没有任何份的建筑，因此理性摒弃它，因为理性在它能给自己建立的最完善的组织里，在把自己形成为一个民族的自我塑造里，必定最明确地找到自己。
但那个知性国家不是一种组织，而是一台机器；民族不是一种共同的、丰富的生命的有机体，而是一个原子式的、缺乏生命的杂多，它的诸要素是绝对对立着的实体，一部分是众多点位，即诸理性存在者，一部分是通过理性——也就是说，在这种形式下：通过知性——可以多方面改变的物质；这些要素的统一是一个概念，它们的联结是一种无止境的统治。
这些点位的绝对实体性建立起一个实践哲学原子论的系统，在其中，如同在自然的原子论里一样，一种对原子来说陌生的知性成了法律，它在实践领域里叫做权利，这是一个总体性的概念，它应当与每一行为对立起来——因为每一行为都是被规定的——去规定它，从而杀死其中活的东西，即真正的同一性。
Fiat iustitia, pereat mundus 就是这条法律，而且不是康德所解释的那个意思40）：权利要得以实现，哪怕世上所有无赖都因此毁灭；而是：权利必须实现，哪怕因此信任、快乐和爱，一个真正伦理的同一性的一切级次，都会像人们说的那样，被连根带枝地铲除掉。

en: We pass over to the system of the ethical community of human beings.
zh: 我们转到人的伦理共同体这一体系。

en: Ethics has it in common with natural law that the idea absolutely rules the drive, freedom absolutely rules nature; but they differ in this, that in natural law the subjection of free beings to the concept in general is an absolute end in itself, so that the fixed abstraction of the common will also stands outside the individual and has power over it.

In ethics the concept and nature must be posited as united in one and the same person; in the state only right is to rule, in the realm of ethical life duty is to have power only insofar as it is recognized as law by the reason of the individual.
zh: 伦理学说与自然法有共同之处：观念绝对地统治着冲动，自由绝对地统治着自然；但两者的区别在于，在自然法里，自由存在者对一般概念的服从本身就是绝对的目的，以至于共同意志那个被固定下来的抽象物也站在个体之外，并对个体拥有暴力。
在伦理学说里，概念和自然必须被设定为在同一个人身上联合起来；在国家里，应当只有权利在统治；在伦理的王国里，义务只有被个体的理性承认为法律，才应当拥有权力。

en: To be one's own master and servant seems indeed to have an advantage over the condition in which the human being is the servant of a stranger.

But the relation of freedom and nature, if in ethical life it is to become a subjective mastery and servitude, a self-suppression of nature, becomes far more unnatural than the relation in natural law, in which what commands and holds power appears as an other, as something situated outside the living individual.
In this relation the living being still has a self-enclosed independence; whatever is not at one within it, it shuts out from itself; what is in conflict with it is a foreign power.
And even if the belief in the unity of the inner with the outer falls away, the belief in its inner agreement, an identity as character, can still persist; the inner nature remains true to itself.

But if in ethics what commands is placed in the human being himself and in him a commanding element and an obedient element are absolutely opposed, then inner harmony is destroyed; disunity and absolute diremption constitute the essence of the human being.
He has to search for a unity, but given an underlying absolute non-identity, only a formal unity remains to him.
zh: 做自己的主人和仆人，看起来确实比人做外人的仆人那种状态要优越一些。
但自由与自然的这种关系，如果要在伦理里变成一种主观的统治和奴役、一种自然对自身的压制，就比自然法里的那种关系要更加不自然得多；在自然法里，发号施令者和掌权者显得是另一个东西，处在活的个体之外。
在这种关系里，活东西仍然有一种自身封闭的独立性；凡在它内部不一致的东西，它都把它排除在自己之外；与之相争的东西是一种外来的力量。
即便对内部与外部之统一的信仰消失了，对自身内部一致的信仰、一种作为品格的同一性，仍然可以持存；内部的本性是忠于自己的。
但如果在伦理学说里，发号施令者被放进人自己里面，并在人身上把发号施令的东西和服从的东西绝对地对立起来，那么内部的和谐就被毁掉了；不一致和绝对的分裂构成了人的本质。
他必须去寻找一种统一，但在绝对的非同一性作为基础的情况下，留给他的只剩下一种形式的统一。

en: The formal unity of the concept that is to rule, and the manifoldness of nature, contradict each other, and the crowding between the two soon displays a significant ill.
The formal concept is to rule; but it is something empty and must be filled through relation to the drive, and so an infinite multitude of possibilities of acting arises.

But if science keeps it in its unity, then through such an empty, formal fundamental proposition it has accomplished nothing. - The I is to determine itself according to the idea of absolute self-activity, to sublate the objective world, is to have causality upon the objective I, thus comes into relation with it; the ethical drive becomes a mixed one41) and thereby as manifold as the objective drive itself is, from which then a great manifoldness of duties emerges.
It can be very much reduced if, like Fichte, one stops at the universality of concepts; but then one again has only formal fundamental propositions.
The opposition of the manifold duties appears under the name of collisions and carries a significant contradiction with it.

If the deduced duties are absolute, they cannot collide; but they necessarily collide because they are opposed; by virtue of their equal absoluteness, choice is possible and, because of the collision, necessary; nothing is present that decides except arbitrariness.

If no arbitrariness were to take place, the duties would not have to stand on the same rank of absoluteness; one would have to be, as one must now put it, more absolute than the other, which contradicts the concept, since every duty as duty is absolute.

But since in this collision action must after all be taken, hence absoluteness abandoned and one duty preferred to another, everything now depends, if a self-determination is to take place, on mediating through judgement the precedence of the one concept of duty over the other and on choosing among the conditioned duties according to the best insight.

If arbitrariness and the contingency of inclinations are excluded from the self-determination of freedom by the highest concept, then self-determination now passes over into the contingency of insight and thereby into the unconsciousness of that by which a contingent insight is decided.

One sees: if Kant in his ethics concedes casuistic questions to every duty posited as absolute, and one is unwilling to believe that he thereby really meant to mock the absoluteness of the posited duty, then it must be assumed that he rather hinted at the necessity of a casuistry for ethics and thereby at the necessity of not trusting one's own insight, which is after all something thoroughly contingent.
It is contingency alone that is to be sublated by an ethics; to transform the contingency of inclinations into the contingency of insight cannot satisfy the ethical drive, which aims at necessity.
zh: 应当进行统治的概念所具有的形式统一，与自然的杂多相互矛盾，而两者之间的挤压很快就显露出一种严重的弊病。
形式的概念应当进行统治；但它是空的，必须通过同冲动发生关系而被充实，于是就产生出无限多的行动可能性。
但如果科学把它保持在它的统一里，那么凭这样一条空洞的、形式的根本命题，科学就什么也没有做成。——我应当按绝对自身活动的观念自己规定自己，去扬弃客观世界，应当对客观的我具有因果性，于是就和它发生关系；伦理的冲动成为一个混合的41）冲动，从而像客观冲动本身那样杂多，由此就产生出大量杂多的义务。
如果像费希特那样停留在概念的普遍性上，这种杂多可以大大减少；但那样一来，人又只有形式上的根本命题了。
各种杂多义务之间的对立以冲突的名义出现，并带来一种严重的矛盾。
如果那些被演绎出来的义务是绝对的，它们就不能相互冲突；但它们必然相互冲突，因为它们是相互对立的；由于它们有同等的绝对性，选择是可能的，而由于冲突，选择又是必然的；除了任意，没有任何东西能作出决断。
如果不允许有任何任意，那么这些义务就不应当处于同一等级的绝对性上；其中一个就必须——现在只能这么说——比另一个更绝对，而这是与概念相矛盾的，因为每条义务作为义务都是绝对的。
但是，既然在这种冲突里终究还是要行动，因而必须放弃绝对性、把一条义务置于另一条之上，那么现在，为了使自我规定能够发生，关键就在于通过评判去协调出这一个义务概念相对于另一个的优先地位，并在那些有条件的义务之间按照最好的见识进行选择。
如果在自由通过最高概念进行的自我规定中，任意和爱好的偶然性被排除掉，那么自我规定现在就转入见识的偶然性，并由此转入对那种决定偶然见识的东西的无意识。
人们看到，如果康德在他的伦理学说里对每一条被设定为绝对的义务都容许有决疑论的问题，而人们又不愿相信他借此其实是在嘲弄所设定的义务的绝对性，那就必须认为，他毋宁是指出了伦理学说需要一种决疑论，从而指出了这样一条必要性：不要信赖自己的见识，因为这种见识完全是偶然的东西。
伦理学说要扬弃的，唯独是偶然性；把爱好的偶然性变成见识的偶然性，并不能满足那种指向必然性的伦理冲动。

en: In such systems of ethics and of natural law, with the fixed, absolute polarity of freedom and necessity, there is no synthesis and no point of indifference to be thought of; transcendentality is wholly lost to the understanding in appearance and its faculty; absolute identity is not found and does not establish itself in it.

The opposition remains absolutely fixed even in the embellishment of infinite progress; it can truly dissolve neither for the individual into the point of indifference of the beauty of the mind and of the work, nor for the complete living community of individuals into a community.
zh: 在这类伦理学和自然法的体系里，面对自由与必然性那种固定的、绝对的两极性，既谈不上综合，也谈不上无差别点；先验性在现象及其能力中，对知性来说完全丢失了；绝对同一性找不到，也不会在现象中把自己建立起来。
对立即使在无限进展这种粉饰里也依然是绝对固定起来的；它既不能在个体那里真正消解为心灵之美和作品之美的无差别点，也不能为个体的完整的、活生生的共同体真正消解为一个社群。

en: To be sure, Fichte too, where among the duties of the various estates he comes to speak of the duties of the aesthetic artist as of one of the last appendages of morality, speaks of the aesthetic sense as a bond of union between understanding and heart; and because the artist turns neither to the understanding alone, like the scholar, nor to the heart alone, like the teacher of the people, but to the whole mind in the union of its faculties42), he ascribes to the aesthetic artist and to aesthetic culture a most effective relation to the furtherance of the purpose of reason43).
zh: 诚然，费希特在谈论各等级的义务、并连带把审美艺术家的义务当作道德的最后的附属品之一来谈时，也把审美感说成知性与心之间的联结纽带；而因为艺术家既不像学者那样只诉诸知性，也不像民众教师那样只诉诸心，而是诉诸在其各种能力统一中的整个心灵42），所以他把一种对促进理性目的极为有效的关系归给审美艺术家和审美教养43）。

en: Apart from the fact that one does not comprehend how in the science that rests on absolute opposition, as this system of ethics does, there can be talk of a bond of union of the understanding and of the heart, of the wholeness of the mind - for absolute determination of nature according to a concept is the absolute domination of the heart by the understanding, which is conditioned by the sublated union -, the wholly subordinate position in which aesthetic culture appears already shows how little, on the whole, it has been counted on for the completion of the system.

Art is relegated to the position of having a most effective relation to the furtherance of the purpose of reason, in that it prepares the ground for morality, so that, when morality enters, it finds half the work already done, namely the liberation from the bonds of sensuousness.
zh: 且不说人们无法理解，在一门像这个伦理学体系那样建立在绝对对立之上的科学里，怎么谈得上知性与心的联结纽带、谈得上心灵的完整性——因为按概念对自然作绝对规定，就是知性对心的绝对统治，而这种统治是以被扬弃了的统一为条件的——，单是审美教养出现时所占的那种完全从属的地位，就已经表明：为了体系的完成，人们一般很少把它计算在内。
艺术被打发到这样的位置：它对促进理性目的有着极为有效的关系，因为它为道德准备好地基，以致道德一出现，就发现一半的工作已经做好了，那就是从感性束缚中解放出来。

en: It is remarkable how Fichte expresses himself about beauty excellently, but inconsistently with regard to his system, makes no application at all of it to that system, and immediately a false application of it to the representation of the moral law.
zh: 值得注意的是，费希特关于美谈得很出色，但就他的体系而言却前后不一：他对这个体系根本不加应用，却马上把这种说法错误地应用到道德法则的表象上。

en: Art, Fichte expresses himself, makes the transcendental point of view into the common one, in that on the former the world is made, on the latter it is given: on the aesthetic one it is given as it is made.

Through the aesthetic faculty a true union of the producing of the intelligence and of the product that appears to it as given - of the I that posits itself as unbounded and at the same time as boundedness - is recognized, or rather a union of the intelligence and of nature, which latter, precisely on account of this possible union, still has another side than that of being a product of the intelligence.

The recognition of the aesthetic union of producing and of the product is something wholly different from the positing of absolute ought and striving and of infinite progress, - concepts that, as soon as that highest union is recognized, announce themselves as antitheses, or merely as syntheses of subordinate spheres, and thus as standing in need of a higher one.
zh: 费希特这样说：艺术把先验的观点变成通常的观点，因为在先验观点上世界是被制作的，在通常观点上世界是被给予的；而在审美观点上，世界是像它被制作的那样被给予的。
通过审美能力，智性的生产和在智性看来作为被给予之物而出现的产物之间的真正统一——即那个把自身设定为无限制、同时又设定为受限状态的我的统一——得到了承认，或者毋宁说，是智性与自然的统一得到了承认；而自然恰恰因为这种可能的统一，还有另一面，即不只是智性的产物。
承认生产和产物的审美统一，与设定绝对的应当和努力、设定无限进展完全是两回事，——后面这些概念一旦那种最高的统一得到承认，就表明自己是反题，或只是较低领域的综合，因而表明自己需要更高的东西。

en: The aesthetic view is further described thus: the given world, nature, has two sides; it is a product of our limitation, and it is a product of our free ideal acting; every shape in space is to be regarded as the expression of the inner fullness and force of the body itself that has it.
Whoever follows the first view sees only distorted, pressed, timorous forms; he sees ugliness.

Whoever follows the latter sees the forceful fullness of nature, life and upward striving; he sees beauty.44) The acting of the intelligence in natural law had produced nature only as a modifiable matter; so it was no free ideal acting, no acting of reason, but of the understanding.
The aesthetic view of nature is now also applied to the moral law, and to be sure nature ought not before the moral law to have the advantage of the capacity for a beautiful view.
The moral law commands absolutely and presses down every natural inclination.
Whoever views it thus relates to it as a slave.
But the moral law is at the same time the I itself, it comes out of the inner depth of our own essence; and when we obey it, we after all only obey ourselves.

Whoever views it thus views it aesthetically.45) - We obey ourselves means: our natural inclination obeys our moral law; but in the aesthetic intuition of nature as the expression of the inner fullness and force of bodies, no such separateness of obeying occurs as we, in ethical life according to this system, in self-obedience, intuit natural inclination as limited by neighbouring reason, the drive as subject to the concept.
This necessary view of this ethical life, instead of being an aesthetic one, must be precisely the one that shows the distorted, timorous, pressed form, ugliness.
zh: 审美观点接下来被进一步这样描述：被给予的世界、即自然，有两个方面；它是我们受到限制的产物，也是我们自由的观念行动的产物；空间中的每一个形态都要被看作拥有它的物体自身之内在充实和力量的表现。
谁跟着第一种观点走，看到的只是扭曲的、被挤压的、畏缩不安的形式；他看到的是丑。
谁跟着后一种观点走，看到的是自然有力的充实、生命和向上生长；他看到的是美。44) 智性在自然法中的行动只把自然生产为一种可改变的物质；所以那不是自由的观念行动，不是理性的行动，而是知性的行动。
对自然的审美观点现在也被用到道德法则上，而自然在道德法则面前当然不该享有能够有一种美的观点这一优越性。
道德法则绝对地下命令，把一切自然倾向都压制下去。
谁这样看待它，谁就是作为奴隶在对待它。
但道德法则同时就是我本身，它出自我们自己本质的内在深处；而我们服从它时，毕竟只是在服从我们自己。
谁这样看待它，就是审美地看待它。45) ——我们服从我们自己，意思是我们的自然倾向服从我们的道德法则；但在把自然视为物体自身之内在充实和力量的表现的审美直观中，并不会出现这样一种服从的分离，就像我们在这种体系下的伦理中、在自我服从里，把自然倾向直观为受邻近的理性限制的东西、把冲动直观为听命于概念的东西那样。
这种伦理的这种必然观点，非但不是一种审美的观点，反而必然是显示出扭曲的、畏缩的、被挤压的形式、即丑的那种观点。

en: If the moral law demands only self-sufficiency as a determining according to and through concepts; and if nature can attain its right only through a limitation of freedom according to the concept of the freedom of many rational beings; and if these two pressed kinds are the highest through which man constitutes himself as man, then for the aesthetic sense, which must be taken in its widest scope, for the completed self-formation of the totality in the union of freedom and necessity, of the conscious and the unconscious, no room is to be found, neither insofar as it presents itself purely in its unbounded self-enjoyment, nor in its restricted appearances, in civil legality and in morality; for in the aesthetic sense precisely all determining according to concepts is so much sublated that this understanding essence of ruling and determining, when it comes to it, is ugly and to be hated.
zh: 如果道德法则要求的只是作为按概念、并通过概念作规定的独立性；如果自然只有通过按众多理性存在者的自由概念对自由作限制，才能获得自己的权利；如果这两种受挤压的方式就是人使自己成为人的最高方式，那么对于审美感——它必须在其最广的范围内被理解——、对于在自由与必然性、意识与无意识的统一中总体性的完成了的自我塑造来说，无论审美感是纯粹在它无限制的自我享受中呈现出来，还是在它受限制的现象中、在市民的合法性中、在道德中呈现出来，都找不到空间；因为在审美感里，一切按概念作规定恰恰被如此彻底地扬弃了，以致这种知性的统治和规定的本质一旦碰到它，就是丑的、是可恨的。
